personal care industry transition to more sustainable polymer-based packaging.

## We are Novolex

Novolex is a leading manufacturer of food, beverage, and specialty packaging servicing customers
across a wide range of industries, including foodservice, restaurant delivery and carryout, food
processing, grocery and retail, and industrial sectors.

With an extensive and innovative product portfolio, we help businesses operate efficiently, meet
evolving customer expectations, and deliver everyday essentials to millions of consumers around the
world.

## Join our team

At Novolex, our people are at the heart of Packaging for a Better Future through choice, innovation,
and sustainability. We offer opportunities to grow, learn, and contribute in meaningful ways across
our manufacturing facilities, offices, and distribution centers. Explore our open roles and see how
you can be part of our growing organization.

[ View Jobs ][26]

## Community

As a leading manufacturer of food, beverage, and specialty packaging, Novolex is uniquely positioned
to help address food insecurity and support the communities where we live and work. Our company-wide
Month of Action is one way we empower our teams to give back. Through local volunteer efforts and
charitable contributions, employees support the organizations and causes that matter most to them
and their families.

[ Learn More ][27]

## Choice, Innovation, & Sustainability

[Product Choices for Your Business Needs]

### Product Choices for Your Business Needs

Novolex offers one of the industry’s broadest portfolios of packaging solutions designed to
safeguard, preserve, and showcase food and beverages for customers across diverse markets.

[ View Products ][28]
[ Innovative Materials to Better Serve Customers]

### Innovative Materials to Better Serve Customers

As market needs evolve, Novolex provides material and product choices that support performance,
sustainability, and speed-to-market. Our teams of material scientists and engineers enable us to
help customers transition to more sustainable alternatives efficiently and effectively.

[Prioritizing Sustainability to Protect Our Planet]

### Prioritizing Sustainability to Protect Our Planet

We fulfill the Novolex promise of choice, innovation and sustainability beginning with the materials
we select. Over time, we have expanded the diversity of substrates used across our product lines to
meet both functional requirements and customer sustainability goals.

[We are Novolex]

## We are Novolex

Novolex is a leading manufacturer of food, beverage, and specialty packaging servicing customers
across a wide range of industries, including foodservice, restaurant delivery and carryout, food
processing, grocery and retail, and industrial sectors.

With an extensive and innovative product portfolio, we help businesses operate efficiently, meet
evolving customer expectations, and deliver everyday essentials to millions of consumers around the
world.

## Join our team

At Novolex, our people are at the heart of Packaging for a Better Future through choice, innovation,
and sustainability. We offer opportunities to grow, learn, and contribute in meaningful ways across
our manufacturing facilities, offices, and distribution centers. Explore our open roles and see how
you can be part of our growing organization.

[ View Jobs ][26]

## Community

As a leading manufacturer of food, beverage, and specialty packaging, Novolex is uniquely positioned
to help address food insecurity and support the communities where we live and work. Our company-wide
Month of Action is one way we empower our teams to give back. Through local volunteer efforts and
charitable contributions, employees support the organizations and causes that matter most to them
and their families.

[ Learn More ][27]

## Choice, Innovation, & Sustainability

[Product Choices for Your Business Needs]

### Product Choices for Your Business Needs

Novolex offers one of the industry’s broadest portfolios of packaging solutions designed to
safeguard, preserve, and showcase food and beverages for customers across diverse markets.

[ View Products ][28]
[ Innovative Materials to Better Serve Customers]

### Innovative Materials to Better Serve Customers

As market needs evolve, Novolex provides material and product choices that support performance,
sustainability, and speed-to-market. Our teams of material scientists and engineers enable us to
help customers transition to more sustainable alternatives efficiently and effectively.

[Prioritizing Sustainability to Protect Our Planet]

### Prioritizing Sustainability to Protect Our Planet

We fulfill the Novolex promise of choice, innovation and sustainability beginning with the materials
we select. Over time, we have expanded the diversity of substrates used across our product lines to
meet both functional requirements and customer sustainability goals.

[ Learn More ][29]

Experience tailored solutions from a committed team dedicated to delivering results and earning your

[RESOURCE HUB][90]

PausePlay

Packaging Applications

## Custom Corrugated Packaging for Every Application

The versatility of corrugated makes it an ideal choice for creating packaging solutions that meet
every need.

[

Contain

The rigors of the road and environmental factors can lead to product damage. Distribute and store
your products with confidence, knowing that PCA engineers designed your packaging to meet your
unique demands.  Learn more about corrugated shipping containers.

][91][

Protect

Sometimes your product requires more than an outside container to help it arrive at its destination
safely. Explore our advanced interior packaging designs for creative solutions.

][92][

Promote

High-impact packaging can grab attention, build brand recognition, and drive sales. PCA offers a
wide variety of print methods that enable your packaging to inform, educate and promote your message
no matter your budget.

][93]

## A box isn’t just a box. Your packaging impacts your entire operation.

Productivity, warehousing space and transportation costs can all be affected by your packaging.
Select custom corrugated packaging to fit every specification and budget.

[
[By Service Icon][By Service Icon]

By Service

Collaborate with experts in packaging design, engineering, testing and project management. Our wide
range of services will set you up for success.

][94]
[
[By Need Icon][By Need Icon]

By Need

Explore corrugated packaging solutions for business, retail or direct to consumers that help
contain, transport, protect, inform and promote your product.

][95]
[
[By Industry Icon][By Industry Icon]

By Industry

Discover some key industries leveraging corrugated to sustainably package their products. Let our
breadth of experience guide you to the ideal solution.

][96]
[Woman Recycling][Woman Recycling]

Sustainable Packaging Solutions

## Corrugated is the most environmentally friendly packaging in the world.

Corrugated packaging is made from a renewable resource grown in managed forests and is the most
recycled packaging material. PCA is also committed to:
* Energy efficiency
* Renewable energy resources
* Responsible design, manufacturing and delivery

[LEARN MORE ABOUT SUSTAINABILITY][97]

[
[Customer Service Managers Overlay Image][Customer Service Managers Overlay Image]
A Message From PCA’s Customer Service Managers
][98]

## Count on us to build outstanding service into everything we do.

A partnership with PCA isn’t just about buying boxes. Our employees are dedicated to building
relationships, providing quality products and delivering an outstanding service experience. At PCA,
our people make the difference.

[explore our packaging solutions][99]

[Map Graphic_2026][Map Graphic_2026]

## From our containerboard mills to our box plants, we’re in markets where you need us.

As one of the largest producers of containerboard and corrugated packaging products in the U.S., PCA
offers customers a world-class experience with local expertise.

[Find Your Nearest Location][100]

Resources

## Step outside the box with industry trends that move you forward.

View articles that highlight specific industry trends and solutions to some common packaging
challenges.

[View More Articles][101]

[
[Reduce Reuse Recycle Dice][Reduce Reuse Recycle Dice]

Why Sustainable Packaging Requires a Lifecycle Perspective

Corrugated offers a compelling combination of renewable materials, strong recovery rates, supply
chain efficiency and measurable environmental advantages.

Industry Insights

Rethinking Corrugated: A Strategic Tool for Engagement

From employee engagement to customer appreciation, curated corrugated gift boxes are a meaningful
way to welcome and recognize both employees and customers.

True Partnership and Collaboration Leads to Packaging Improvement

“At PCA, we have a customer-first mindset, so I’m always looking for ways to improve the overall
experience,” he said. That mindset led to an unexpected moment of inspiration outside the workplace.

Industry Insights

[Dad and daughter buying frozen pasta][Dad and daughter buying frozen pasta]

Quarterly Industry Bulletin

As frozen product assortments expand beyond traditional meals to include snacks, desserts, and

Don’t worry if your project is complex or comes with stringent requirements. We’ll find the custom

## A box isn’t just a box. Your packaging impacts your entire operation.

Productivity, warehousing space and transportation costs can all be affected by your packaging.
Select custom corrugated packaging to fit every specification and budget.

Sustainable Packaging Solutions

## Corrugated is the most environmentally friendly packaging in the world.

Corrugated packaging is made from a renewable resource grown in managed forests and is the most
recycled packaging material. PCA is also committed to:
* Energy efficiency
* Renewable energy resources
* Responsible design, manufacturing and delivery

## Count on us to build outstanding service into everything we do.

A partnership with PCA isn’t just about buying boxes. Our employees are dedicated to building
relationships, providing quality products and delivering an outstanding service experience. At PCA,
our people make the difference.

offers customers a world-class experience with local expertise.

## Multimaterial Packaging Distributors

Single-item packaging is hardly efficient when attempting to streamline large-scale distribution, so
you’ll often see multiple units contained in one box. If you deal in the transport of sensitive
materials, like glass containers or fragile electronics, you’d likely prefer to avoid risking the
loss of inventory while in transit.

As a [custom box manufacturer][83], we can combine several materials to insulate your products
better. Substrates that see frequent application include bubble wrap, paper, foam and corrugated. We
also craft boxes and other containers to feature a Nomar coating, which eliminates the common
abrasion between your packaged item and the inside of the shipping crate.

## Customer-Focused Packaging Distributors

What good is a package when empty? We’ve built our premium reputation thanks in huge part to our
trusted customers and clients, who drive our business, and that’s why your satisfaction remains at
the heart of everything we do. We continually strive to rise above vanilla, generic packaging, as
we’ll maintain a constant line of communication with you throughout the process to document your
goals, product details, industry requirements, needs and limitations.

With our [custom packaging designs][84], you’ll never feel like you could have done better
elsewhere. We’ll fine-tune every aspect to ensure a perfect fit while giving you the best value for
your money.

[Learn More][85]

## A Product House Built for Global Buyers

[ Learn Our Story ][44]

**AARUMI GLOBAL** works at the meeting point of product development, global sourcing, private label
supply, packaging solutions and wholesale supply.

We support buyers who need more than a product list. They need clear specifications, reliable
communication, MOQ guidance, packaging direction, supplier coordination and export-ready planning.

Our first visible chapter begins with **AARUMI Leather Goods** — wallets, cardholders and everyday
accessories shaped by material, function, proportion and finishing.

But AARUMI GLOBAL is built beyond one category. Our direction extends into lifestyle products,
gifting, home & living, packaging and future private-label collections.

> "Products should feel ready for the shelf before they reach the shelf."

We are here for buyers who value thoughtful sourcing, calm communication and refined supply.

## The Contract Packaging Partner You Can Count On

When your product is ready to move, you need a partner who executes flawlessly. That’s where we come
in. With **over 32 years in business for both Food and Non-Food solutions**, we’ve become the
**go-to source for contract packaging** by doing three things exceptionally well: *moving fast,
managing projects seamlessly, and delivering a customer experience* that truly matters.

### Quick Turnaround

We know speed matters. Our streamlined processes and experienced teams keep projects moving
efficiently, without cutting corners.

### Seamless Project Management

From kickoff to final shipment, we manage the supply chain and handle all the details, including
sourcing of raw components and material selection. Clear communication, proactive problem-solving,
and accountability at every step mean fewer surprises for you.

### A Truly Great Customer Experience

We’re easy to work with, responsive, and invested in your success. Clients stay with us because we
treat their products like our own, and their timelines like they’re mission-critical.

### Experience That Shows

Three decades of hands-on expertise across thousands of retail packaging projects means we’ve seen
it all, and we know how to handle the simple projects to the very complex ones. We get it done
right. Whether you’re launching something new or scaling an existing program, you’ll feel the
difference that experience makes.

### Ready to Start Your Project?

Whether you are a large consumer packaged goods (CPG) company or an established start-up looking for
support from a reputable packaging specialist, call us at 877-273-6259 or Fill in the “[Request for
Quote][57]” form. A sales manager will follow up with you within 1 hour.

## Packaging with Purpose

Explore our recyclable products for all use occasions including cans, bottles, ends and aerosol

###### Beverage Cans

Whether it's beer, water, or soda, Ball cans offer visually appealing, crowd-pleasing packaging in
various styles and sizes.

###### Beverage Bottles

Ball aluminum bottles are a game-changer for sporting events, concert venues and the always active
beverage consumer.
[Learn More][68] [Aluminum aerosol can]

###### Aerosol Cans

Ball's aluminum aerosol cans boast high-definition designs and award-winning innovations for your
brand to shine.
[Learn More][69]
[Reaching Real Circularity]

### Reaching Real Circularity

"At Ball, we strive to create the perfect circle for our packaging products so that the materials
can be used over and over. We are striving toward our 2030 commitments."
 
* Align the industry to achieve a 90% global recycling rate for aluminum beverage cans, bottles and
  cups (2030).
* Work together with our supply chain partners to achieve an 85% average recycled content in the
  aluminum used to produce beverage cans, bottles and cups in the regions where we operate (2030).
* Launch second generation of ReAl® aerosol container technology with 75% recycled content (2030).

[Reaching Real Circularity]

### Reaching Real Circularity

"At Ball, we strive to create the perfect circle for our packaging products so that the materials
can be used over and over. We are striving toward our 2030 commitments."
 
* Align the industry to achieve a 90% global recycling rate for aluminum beverage cans, bottles and
  cups (2030).
* Work together with our supply chain partners to achieve an 85% average recycled content in the
  aluminum used to produce beverage cans, bottles and cups in the regions where we operate (2030).
* Launch second generation of ReAl® aerosol container technology with 75% recycled content (2030).

# Custom Packaging and Displays for Lasting First Impressions

We create, produce, and deliver custom packaging and display solutions that outshine your
competition, outlast the journey, and outsell on the shelf.

[ Start Your Project ][65]

Trusted by the World’s Leading Retailers

## What We Do Best

Discover the right packaging or point-of-purchase display for every product, every channel, every
campaign.

[

### Custom Retail Displays

Eye-catching, branded in-store retail displays that engage shoppers and put your product front and
center.
][66]
[

### Retail Packaging

Custom retail packaging that showcases your brand and meets every retailer requirement—built to
stand out and protect.
][67]
[

### Industrial Packaging

Industrial packaging engineered for strength and value—protecting your products through shipping and
storage.
][68]
[

### E-Commerce and Subscription Packaging

Custom product packaging boxes for e-commerce and subscriptions—durable, branded, and ready for
every doorstep.
][69]
[

### Specialty Beverage Packaging

Make your wine and specialty drinks stand out with retail-ready beverage packaging solutions,
including variety rework, gift sets, and custom bundles.
][70]

## Bringing Your Ideas to the Shelf for Over 70 Years

We’ve been helping brands make bold first impressions for over 70 years. As a 100% employee-owned
packaging and point of purchase display company, our award-winning creatives are committed to
designing sustainable packaging that doesn’t just pop on the market—it redefines what packaging can
do for your brand and the planet.

From ideation to the last mile of delivery, we’re here to help you unbox results and raise the bar,
every single time.

[ About Us ][71]
Sustainable by Design

At Bay Cities, we’re vertically integrated to give you full-service packaging solutions that are
better for your business and the planet. By owning our corrugator and partnering closely with New
Indy Paper Mill, we secure a reliable stream of responsibly sourced, recycled paper. Our corrugator
runs on 100% renewable energy, powered by steam from the mill itself. 

From tree to paper, to corrugate, to packaging or display, and back again, your box is part of a
continuous cycle. Once it’s recycled, the process starts over, again and again. We help keep that
loop alive by designing with recyclability in mind and using up to 99% post-consumer materials. 

Together, we’ll reduce your environmental impact with packaging that does good, and looks great
doing it. 

[ Read More ][72]
1 Recycled Materials

Old corrugated cartons are sent to New Indy Paper Mill, where up to 99% of post-consumer content is
used to make paper. They are recycled into 264" wide rolls and turned into new sheets at our sheet
feeder, Encorr Sheets. These sheets are delivered to our plant and converted into new packaging and
displays.

2 Renewable Energy

Our corrugator, Encorr, is powered by the off energy produced by the New Indy Paper Mill,
eliminating the need for additional greenhouse gas emissions.

3 Sustainably Certified

Bay Cities is certified according to FSC ® and SFI ® standards for sourcing materials. This means
our corrugate is responsibly sourced from forest to conversion.

DAILY NEWS PRESS RELEASES
* ### [The Most Expensive AI Mistake in Biotech Isn’t a Hallucination, It’s a Process Failure][43]
  
  Jul 24 | **Bio-IT World** | The most expensive AI failures in biotech and pharma are unlikely to
  come from a model inventing a sentence. They are more likely to come from organizations treating
  AI as a standalone tool instead of a controlled business process. That distinction matters because
  regulated life sciences have spent decades building systems around process integrity. [More][44]
* ### [In Vivo CRISPR Therapy is One Step Closer to the Clinic][45]
  
  Jul 23 | **Bio-IT World** | ﻿A one-time, in vivo CRISPR gene-editing therapy from Intellia
  Therapeutics could become the first approved treatment of its kind for patients with hereditary
  angioedema. The experimental therapy, lonvoguran ziclumeran (lonvo-z), reduced hereditary
  angioedema (HAE) attacks by 87% in a phase 3 trial and could be submitted for regulatory review in
  the United States and Europe within the next year. [More][46]
* ### [Different Teams, Same Problem][47]
  
  Jul 22 | **Bio-IT World** | ﻿Receiving a Bio-IT World Best of Show Award for OmicsHQ was a
  tremendous honor. More importantly, it provided an opportunity to engage with the researchers,
  data scientists, and technology leaders who ultimately determine whether products like ours
  succeed or fail. [More][48]
* ### [Winning Best of Show Again: A Reflection on MLADU, Research Data, and the Bio-IT World
  ### Community][49]
  
  Jul 21 | **Bio-IT World** | ﻿When Dantech Corporation created MLADU, we were not trying to build a
  product that would win awards. We were trying to solve a problem that we kept seeing in the real
  world: research organizations, consortia, biopharma teams, clinical partners, and technology teams
  needed to move important data securely, reliably, and with accountability, but the process was
  often far more slow and difficult than it should be. [More][50]
* ### [With AWS Help, UK Group Moves Toward Global AMR Intelligence Platform][51]
  
  Jul 16 | **Bio-IT World** | ﻿Amazon Web Services has come alongside the UK’s The Fleming
  Initiative, offering up to several million pounds worth of cloud and AI technology, as well as
  technical support, for the Initiative’s global antimicrobial resistance (AMR) intelligence
  platform. [More][52]
* ### [CFDE Promotes Collaboration to Build Creative and Practical Solutions to Data Challenges
  ### during the Bio-IT Hackathon][53]
  
  Jul 15 | **Bio-IT World** | The 2026 Bio-IT FAIR Data Hackathon kicked-off the 25th Bio-IT World
  Conference & Expo by welcoming 32 data scientists, software developers, students, and life science
  professionals to address real-world data challenges using Open Source and FAIR (Findable,
  Accessible, Interoperable, Reusable) data principles. [More][54]
* ### [How Sugar on Brain Cells May Be Driving Alzheimer’s and How a Common Joint Supplement May Be
  ### Making It Worse][55]
  
  Jul 14 | **Bio-IT World** | ﻿While most of the research on Alzheimer’s Disease (AD) in the last few
  decades has focused on amyloid-beta plaques and the tau tangles—the misfolded debris cluttering
  and hindering normal brain function—a group at the University of Florida has identified a new
  angle of pursuit by performing an unbiased survey of all the different fats, sugars, and small
  molecule metabolites in the brains of Alzheimer’s patients. [More][56]
* ### [Signal Management Isn’t Broken; It Simply Belongs to a Previous Era][57]
  
  Jul 10 | **Bio-IT World** | ﻿Drug safety discussions rarely take into account how pharmacovigilance
  might change if the adverse event case-processing bottleneck was eliminated altogether. Yet this
  reality is within reach now thanks to advanced technology. As an industry we have digitized the
  paperwork and accelerated individual steps, but the overall workflow remains largely sequential,
  manual at its core, and oriented around periodic snapshots rather than conti

DAILY NEWS PRESS RELEASES
* ### [The Most Expensive AI Mistake in Biotech Isn’t a Hallucination, It’s a Process Failure][43]
  
  Jul 24 | **Bio-IT World** | The most expensive AI failures in biotech and pharma are unlikely to
  come from a model inventing a sentence. They are more likely to come from organizations treating
  AI as a standalone tool instead of a controlled business process. That distinction matters because
  regulated life sciences have spent decades building systems around process integrity. [More][44]
* ### [In Vivo CRISPR Therapy is One Step Closer to the Clinic][45]
  
  Jul 23 | **Bio-IT World** | ﻿A one-time, in vivo CRISPR gene-editing therapy from Intellia
  Therapeutics could become the first approved treatment of its kind for patients with hereditary
  angioedema. The experimental therapy, lonvoguran ziclumeran (lonvo-z), reduced hereditary
  angioedema (HAE) attacks by 87% in a phase 3 trial and could be submitted for regulatory review in
  the United States and Europe within the next year. [More][46]
* ### [Different Teams, Same Problem][47]
  
  Jul 22 | **Bio-IT World** | ﻿Receiving a Bio-IT World Best of Show Award for OmicsHQ was a
  tremendous honor. More importantly, it provided an opportunity to engage with the researchers,
  data scientists, and technology leaders who ultimately determine whether products like ours
  succeed or fail. [More][48]
* ### [Winning Best of Show Again: A Reflection on MLADU, Research Data, and the Bio-IT World
  ### Community][49]
  
  Jul 21 | **Bio-IT World** | ﻿When Dantech Corporation created MLADU, we were not trying to build a
  product that would win awards. We were trying to solve a problem that we kept seeing in the real
  world: research organizations, consortia, biopharma teams, clinical partners, and technology teams
  needed to move important data securely, reliably, and with accountability, but the process was
  often far more slow and difficult than it should be. [More][50]
* ### [With AWS Help, UK Group Moves Toward Global AMR Intelligence Platform][51]
  
  Jul 16 | **Bio-IT World** | ﻿Amazon Web Services has come alongside the UK’s The Fleming
  Initiative, offering up to several million pounds worth of cloud and AI technology, as well as
  technical support, for the Initiative’s global antimicrobial resistance (AMR) intelligence
  platform. [More][52]
* ### [CFDE Promotes Collaboration to Build Creative and Practical Solutions to Data Challenges
  ### during the Bio-IT Hackathon][53]
  
  Jul 15 | **Bio-IT World** | The 2026 Bio-IT FAIR Data Hackathon kicked-off the 25th Bio-IT World
  Conference & Expo by welcoming 32 data scientists, software developers, students, and life science
  professionals to address real-world data challenges using Open Source and FAIR (Findable,
  Accessible, Interoperable, Reusable) data principles. [More][54]
* ### [How Sugar on Brain Cells May Be Driving Alzheimer’s and How a Common Joint Supplement May Be
  ### Making It Worse][55]
  
  Jul 14 | **Bio-IT World** | ﻿While most of the research on Alzheimer’s Disease (AD) in the last few
  decades has focused on amyloid-beta plaques and the tau tangles—the misfolded debris cluttering
  and hindering normal brain function—a group at the University of Florida has identified a new
  angle of pursuit by performing an unbiased survey of all the different fats, sugars, and small
  molecule metabolites in the brains of Alzheimer’s patients. [More][56]
* ### [Signal Management Isn’t Broken; It Simply Belongs to a Previous Era][57]
  
  Jul 10 | **Bio-IT World** | ﻿Drug safety discussions rarely take into account how pharmacovigilance
  might change if the adverse event case-processing bottleneck was eliminated altogether. Yet this
  reality is within reach now thanks to advanced technology. As an industry we have digitized the
  paperwork and accelerated individual steps, but the overall workflow remains largely sequential,
  manual at its core, and oriented around periodic snapshots rather than continuous monitoring.
  [More][58]
* ### [Network Effects: John Quackenbush on How Networks Illuminate Biology Beyond Gene
  ### Expression][59]
  
  Jul 09 | **Bio-IT World** | A group of researchers is sounding the alarm: the publicly funded data
  infrastructure underpinning virtually all of modern biomedical research is fragile, underfunded,
  and increasingly at risk. It is up to us to safeguard it. At a session at last month’s Bio-IT
  World Conference & Expo, Douaa Mugahid, PhD, Data Officer at the Hi-IMPAcTB Consortium at the
  Harvard School of Public Health moderated a panel of academics, investors, and consultants to take
  on the future of public data and software infrastructure. [More][60]
* ### [Insilico Medicine Launches Phase III Trial for AI-Developed Drug][61]
  
  Jul 08 | **Bio-IT World** | ﻿Insilico Medicine is launching a phase III clinical program for
  rentosertib, its potentially first-in-class oral small-molecule inhibitor of TNIK (TRAF2- and
  NCK-interacting kinase) for the treatment of idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (IPF), a progressive,
  age-related fibrotic lung disease with high unmet medical need. It is the next step in making
  AI-discovered drugs a reality for patients. [More][62]
* ### [Thermo Fisher Scientific Launches Thermo Scientific™ InstaFlux™ to Help Food Microbiology
  ### Labs Simplify Workflows in Pathogen and Environmental Testing][63]
  
  Jul 24 | Thermo Fisher Scientific today announced the global launch of Thermo Scientific™
  InstaFlux™, an integrated media-on-demand enrichment workflow that helps food microbiology
  laboratories simplify media preparation, improve productivity and enhance sample traceability.
  [More][64]
* ### [ELRIG Appoints Drs Hitesh Sanganee and Marcus Schindler to Scientific Advisory Board][65]
  
  Jul 23 | Leadership expansion reinforces ELRIG's commitment to delivering impactful drug discovery
  initiatives and driving community-wide collaboration [More][66]
* ### [Novo Nordisk Challenges Lilly’s GLP-1 Advertising Campaigns, Claiming Consumers Are Misled by
  ### Outdated Comparisons][67]
  
  Jul 22 | Novo Nordisk has filed a lawsuit against Eli Lilly, claiming that Lilly’s GLP-1
  advertising campaigns use outdated comparisons and mislead consumers about obesity and diabetes
  treatments. The dispute focuses on advertisements comparing Zepbound® and Mounjaro® with lower
  doses of Wegovy® and Ozempic®. Novo Nordisk is seeking removal of the campaigns and corrective
  advertising to ensure patients receive updated scientific information. The case highlights
  increasing competition between leading pharmaceutical companies in the fast-growing GLP-1 therapy
  market. [More][68]
* ### [Pythia BioSciences and Lexogen Partner to Unify Multi-Omics Data Curation and Analytics with
  ### Bulk and Single-Cell RNA Sequencing][69]
  
  Jul 22 | Pythia BioSciences and Lexogen formed a strategic partnership to combine Lexogen's RNA
  sequencing and wet-lab expertise with Pythia's multi-omics data curation, analytics, and expanding
  data ecosystem. The collaboration enables researchers to move from curated public datasets to
  custom bulk and single-cell RNA-seq experiments using biobank samples, creating analysis-ready
  datasets that accelerate drug discovery. [More][70]
* ### [New leadership, new ambition: Malvern Panalytical accelerates strategy under President
  ### Christian Sauber][71]
  
  Jul 22 | Backed by KKR’s £4.7 billion acquisition of Malvern Panalytical parent company Spectris,
  the materials characterization leader enters a new era of innovation, customer focus, and
  long-term ambition. [More][72]
* ### [MIB Agents Osteosarcoma Alliance Appoints Katherine Azima as Co-Director of Scientific
  ### Programs ][73]
  
  Jul 21 | MIB Agents Osteosarcoma Alliance, a nonprofit dedicated to Making It Better for the
  osteosarcoma community through research, education and patient support, today announced that
  Katherine Azima has joined the organization as Co-Director of Scientific Programs. In this role,
  Azima will work alongside Christina Ip-Toma, Co-Director of Scientific Programs, until Ip-Toma
  retires at the end of the year, to help lead and expand MIB Agents' growing portfolio of
  scientific initiatives, fostering collaboration among researchers, clinicians, industry partners
  and patient advocates to accelerate progress in osteosarcoma research. [More][74]
* ### [Lilly to Acquire AtaiBeckley to Advance Innovative Biotech Therapies for Treatment-Resistant
  ### Depression][75]
  
  Jul 21 | Eli Lilly and Company has announced a definitive agreement to acquire clinical-stage
  biotechnology company AtaiBeckley in a deal valued at up to $3.8 billion, including
  milestone-based payments. The acquisition significantly expands Lilly's neuroscience pipeline with
  innovative rapid-acting neuroplastogen therapies for treatment-resistant depression and other
  serious mental health disorders. The transaction highlights growing pharmaceutical investment in
  next-generation psychiatric medicines designed to deliver durable symptom relief through novel
  mechanisms of action. [More][76]
* ### [Sanofi Wins FDA Approval for First On-Body Injector Cancer Treatment, Making Multiple Myeloma
  ### Care Simpler][77]
  
  Jul 13 | The FDA has approved Sanofi's Sarclisa Escena, making it the first anticancer therapy
  that can be administered through a wearable on-body injector. Clinical studies showed the new
  subcutaneous treatment delivers effectiveness comparable to intravenous therapy while reducing
  administration time and infusion-related reactions. The approval is expected to improve both
  patient convenience and healthcare workflow in the treatment of multiple myeloma. [More][78]
* ### [Novogene Europe Launches Untargeted Metabolomics Service at Cambridge Omics Centre][79]
  
  Jul 13 | • Strengthens multiomics portfolio offering metabolite-level insight to connect molecular
  data with biological function across broader life science studies • New workflow built around
  Thermo Scientific Vanquish UHPLC coupled with Orbitrap Exploris 120 high-resolution accurate-mass
  mass spectrometry [More][80]
* ### [Amprion and Modality.AI Break New Ground in Multimodal Assessment for Neurodegenerative
  ### Disease][81]
  
  Jul 10 | Amprion and Modality.AI announce partnership to explore how molecular biomarkers and
  AI-enabled digital assessments can be combined to improve the characterization of
  neurodegenerative diseases [More][82]

**About Us**
Buske Logistics is a privately owned and operated third-party logistics (3PL) warehousing business
founded in 1923. Since 2009, the company has undergone a significant transformation, with Fortune
1,000 standards being implemented under the ownership of S.C. Johnson & Son, Inc. from 2009 to 2015.

New and enhanced systems, processes, and people development have been priorities under the current
management team, which acquired the company in 2015. Most recently, we have accelerated our capital
investments through a partnership with Fourshore Partners in March of 2022.

We are a global company providing a wide array of best-in-class logistics services to Fortune 500
clients in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico. Since our inception, we have been committed to offering our
partners the kind of personal attention that results in quick answers, superior value, cutting-edge
technology, and the most reliable performance in our industry.

## **42 Locations**

[Image of Buske's 30 locations across the U.S. and Canada]

## **Our History**

Our 100+ year history in the warehousing and logistics industry, combined with our ever-evolving
innovation and technological capabilities, keeps us firmly planted as a preeminent 3PL organization.

Since day one, we’ve fulfilled the most demanding needs of Fortune 1,000 companies across various
industries, from food and beverage to automotive manufacturing.

# We rethink packaging every day.

We are Constantia Flexibles, a global leader in consumer and pharmaceutical flexible packaging.

[Find out more][30]

## Pharma Business

Together with our partners, we protect health and ensure the safety of patients and their loved
ones.

[About Pharma][31]

## Consumer Business

We aim to provide people with the highest benefit daily at the lowest impact on the environment.

[About Consumer][32]

## People Passion Packaging

Based on the guiding principle of People Passion Packaging, we globally manufacture tailor-made
flexible packaging solutions.

## We Design for Recycling

With more than 110 years of experience in flexible packaging, we know that high‑quality and visually
appealing packaging is only part of the story. Today, packaging also needs to work within modern
recycling systems and meet evolving customer expectations.


That’s why we apply Design for Recycling principles across our development processes. Our
**Ecolutions portfolio** includes flexible packaging solutions engineered to support established
recycling streams wherever possible. These products are designed to perform strongly, protect goods,
and be handled more efficiently at end‑of‑life within available infrastructure.
 

By continuously improving material choices, design features, and production technologies, we help
customers move toward packaging that aligns with the requirements of tomorrow’s markets.

Jobs & Career

## Your career at Constantia Flexibles

No matter if you want to start or to further develop in your career, Constantia Flexibles offers
meaningful jobs that contribute to a better tomorrow, creating packaging solutions that protect
goods and the environment and save lives. Explore our job opportunities and learn more about us.

[Career at Constantia][33]

## Explore our culture

At Constantia Flexibles, we are passionate about what we do and want to play a part in making
tomorrow’s world a better place. Find out more about our culture, our core values and whom do we
seek on board.

[ Learn more ][34]

## Job openings

Join us and unwrap your talent!

[ Apply ][35]

## Shop By Category

It’s what’s inside that matters. This is the outside (which also matters). Start with the right
material (glass, plastic, recycled, or metal), then dial in size, color, and finish. Closures are
here too, if you’re ready for us to put a lid on it.
[[Plastic Containers]

### Plastic

Plastic bottles, jars, and containers in PET, HDPE, PP, and other fun acronyms.
][16][[Glass Containers]

### Glass

Glass bottles and jars for food, beverage, fragrance, and things sold in dimly lit shops.
][17][[Recycled Plastic Containers]

### Recycled

Post-Consumer-Resin (PCR) containers made from plastic with a previous life.

][18][[Metal Containers]

# Custom Boxes Tailored for Every Product, Designed for Every Need

No product is the same, and neither should its packaging be. From sturdy protective solutions to
luxury presentations, our custom boxes are designed to fit every shape, style, and industry need.
Whether it’s minimalist kraft for sustainability, rigid boxes for premium appeal, or innovative
die-cut designs for branding impact, we craft packaging that goes beyond containment—it enhances,
protects, and elevates your product’s presence.

## Material Excellence – Strength, Sustainability & Versatility for Every Product

The foundation of great packaging starts with the right material. Whether it’s eco-friendly kraft
for a natural appeal, sturdy cardboard for everyday reliability, or premium rigid stock for an
elevated brand presence, we provide materials that ensure strength, sustainability, and stunning
presentation. Each selection is carefully tailored to match product protection needs, industry
standards, and customer expectations, making sure your packaging feels as good as it looks.

## Precision Shapes – Designed to Fit, Styled to Impress

Every product demands a box shape that complements its form and function. From classic square and
rectangular designs for secure stacking to eye-catching pillow, tulip, gable, pyramid, and diamond
shapes that elevate presentation, our custom boxes are crafted to enhance visibility, improve
handling, and create a memorable unboxing experience. Whether sleek and professional or bold and
innovative, each shape is designed to seamlessly align with your brand’s vision and product needs.

## Structural Design Mastery – Functionality Meets Aesthetic Excellence

Custom boxes are more than just containers—they are engineered for usability, durability, and brand
impact. From secure tuck-end closures for effortless assembly to sleeve and two-piece boxes that add
a touch of elegance, every style is designed to enhance product accessibility, reinforce protection,
and create a seamless unboxing experience. Whether for retail display, secure shipping, or premium
presentation, our structural innovations ensure that every box not only holds a product but elevates
its perceived value.

## Luxury & Durability Combined – Rigid Boxes for a Premium Experience

True luxury packaging is more than just aesthetics—it’s about strength, sophistication, and a
seamless unboxing experience. Our rigid boxes are crafted from high-quality materials to provide
unmatched durability and premium appeal, making them ideal for high-end retail, gifts, and luxury
branding. Whether it’s the magnetic closure boxes that exude elegance, the flip-top and book-style
designs that offer a sleek reveal, or the collapsible styles that combine storage efficiency with
refined presentation, each box is tailored to elevate your product’s value and create lasting
impressions. With options like drawer-style and sleeve-and-tray configurations, we ensure that every
product is not just housed but presented with perfection.

## Vivid Branding & Eco-Friendly Printing – Bringing Your Packaging to Life

Every box is an extension of your brand, and high-quality printing ensures that your message stands
out. We offer precision printing techniques that bring designs to life with rich colors, crisp
details, and sustainable solutions.

From CMYK for vibrant full-color visuals to PMS for precise brand-matched tones, our printing
capabilities allow for stunning graphics inside and out, ensuring a seamless brand experience from
the moment the package is opened. Using water-based, soy, and vegetable inks, we provide
eco-conscious printing solutions that maintain bold, high-definition results while minimizing
environmental impact.

capabilities allow for stunning graphics inside and out, ensuring a seamless brand experience from
the moment the package is opened. Using water-based, soy, and vegetable inks, we provide
eco-conscious printing solutions that maintain bold, high-definition results while minimizing
environmental impact.

Whether you want subtle elegance or bold statement packaging, our advanced printing technology
ensures that your packaging is as compelling as the product inside.

## Premium Finishes & Protective Coatings – Elevating Aesthetics & Durability

A well-crafted box isn’t just about structure—it’s about the perfect finishing touch that enhances
visual appeal, texture, and longevity. Our premium finishes and coatings bring luxury, protection,
and distinction to every package, ensuring that your brand stands out effortlessly.

For a high-end, sophisticated appeal, choose from gold or silver foiling to add a touch of elegance
and exclusivity. Our soft-touch and matte laminations create a luxurious feel, while holographic
finishes deliver a bold, modern aesthetic. To ensure lasting durability, our UV coatings and aqueous
finishes provide scratch resistance, moisture protection, and a sleek surface. Whether it’s a subtle
sheen or a striking gloss effect, our custom coatings and finishes ensure that your packaging looks
stunning, feels premium, and lasts longer—reinforcing brand prestige and product protection in every
box.

## Custom Inserts & Die-Cut Features – Precision Protection & Engaging Presentation

A well-structured box deserves an interior that securely holds, protects, and enhances the product
inside. Our custom inserts and die-cut features provide optimal product security while elevating the
unboxing experience, ensuring that every detail aligns with your brand’s premium standards.

For delicate or high-value products, our foam inserts, pillow inserts, and punch partitions offer
tailored cushioning and structured placement, reducing movement and preventing damage. Meanwhile,
window cutouts and PVC windows allow for product visibility, enticing customers with a preview
before they even open the box.

Whether you need luxurious product staging, functional compartmentalization, or interactive design
elements, our precision-engineered inserts and die-cut features turn packaging into a seamless
fusion of security and sophistication.

## Industry-Specific Packaging – Tailored Solutions for Every Business

Different industries demand different packaging solutions, and we craft custom boxes that align
perfectly with your product’s purpose, branding, and market expectations. Whether it’s luxury
presentation, food-grade safety, or durable retail packaging, our expertise ensures that every
detail is designed for maximum impact, protection, and customer engagement.

## Cosmetic, Makeup & Jewelry Packaging – Elevating Luxury & Brand Prestige

Luxury brands require aesthetic perfection, durability, and premium finishing. Our rigid and
two-piece boxes with soft-touch laminations, gold foiling, and embossing ensure an unforgettable
unboxing experience, reinforcing exclusivity. Custom inserts, such as velvet foam trays, protect
delicate products, while inside-out printing ensures brand messaging from the first glance to the
final reveal.

## Food & Bakery Packaging – Safety, Freshness & Visual Appeal

Food packaging isn’t just about presentation—it’s about protection and compliance. Our food-safe
kraft, cardboard, and aqueous-coated packaging ensures freshness, grease resistance, and
eco-friendly disposal. Whether it’s fast-food boxes with secure roll-end closures or bakery boxes
with die-cut windows for irresistible display, we design packaging that keeps products safe,
hygienic, and visually enticing.

## Retail, Apparel & Promotional Packaging – Driving Brand Visibility & Engagement

In retail, packaging is an extension of the product and brand story. Our customized shapes, striking
prints, and premium finishes make boxes instantly recognizable and shareable. From rigid gift boxes
with ribbon closures for upscale branding to sturdy apparel boxes with hang-tab features, we ensure
every product is presented with sophistication and impact.

## Pharmaceutical & Hotel Packaging – Compliance, Protection & Brand Identity

Medical and hospitality packaging requires precision, sterility, and branding consistency. Our
pharmaceutical boxes are designed for secure handling, using strong cardboard or rigid stock for
durability and tamper-proofing. For hotel and amenity kits, our packaging enhances guest experience
with structured layouts, soft-touch coatings, and minimalistic branding that exudes class. No matter
the industry, our tailor-made packaging guarantees that your product is protected, presented, and
positioned exactly as intended—reinforcing trust, enhancing appeal, and delivering a premium
customer experience.

## Complete Customization – Every Detail, Every Dimension, Fully Tailored to Your Needs

Your product is unique, and your packaging should be too. We offer fully customized boxes in any
size, shape, and structure, ensuring that your packaging aligns perfectly with your product
dimensions, branding, and customer experience goals.

### Custom Sizes for a Perfect Fit

Avoid unnecessary bulk or wasted space—our precision-engineered custom sizes ensure a snug, secure,
and cost-efficient solution for every product. Whether it's compact retail packaging, spacious
bakery boxes, or specialized pharmaceutical cartons, we create boxes that maximize functionality
without compromise.

### Unique Shapes for Brand Distinction

Go beyond the ordinary with custom-shaped boxes that amplify product appeal. Whether it’s curved
edges, pyramid structures, pillow shapes, or diamond-cut designs, we craft visually engaging
packaging that enhances your brand’s market presence.

### Tailored Structural Elements for Enhanced Usability

From hang-tab display boxes for retail prominence to magnetic closure rigid boxes for high-end
presentation, our custom designs prioritize convenience, durability, and branding impact. Features
like window cutouts, perforated tear strips, and secure locking tabs offer a refined balance of
aesthetics and functionality.

### Brand-Enhancing Finishes & Personalization

Every element, from color and print to texture and embellishments, is fully customizable. Whether
you need luxury foiling, embossed branding, eco-friendly soy-based printing, or minimalist matte
finishes, we ensure your packaging is a seamless extension of your brand identity.

With endless customization possibilities, your packaging becomes a strategic asset—creating
differentiation, increasing customer engagement, and ensuring a premium product experience from
first glance to final touch.

## Seamless Brand Experience – Packaging That Engages, Protects & Converts

A box isn’t just a container—it’s a brand statement, an interactive experience, and a powerful
marketing tool. We ensure that every element of your packaging enhances brand perception, reinforces
product value, and creates an unforgettable customer journey. With intelligent design, premium
materials, and customer-centric innovation, our packaging does more than protect—it elevates,
engages, and drives long-term brand loyalty.

Progress toward sustainability goals without sacrificing performance

### 
### Supporting a circular economy, including recycling is a major priority across the US and Canada.
### Meeting these targets starts with having a recycle-ready package. We'll make sure yours is.

Post Consumer Resin (PCR)

Governments and major brands are legislating using more PCR in consumer packaging. We’ll help you
meet this growing demand while maintaining high-quality graphics and performance.

Post Industrial Resin (PIR)

Just like PCR, PIR packaging replaces virgin materials but at an even better price point and a
higher quality standard.

Conventional

Conventional packing films are proven and cost-effective. They look great, resist punctures,
withstand high temperatures, and provide barrier protection when needed.

Bio-Based

Reduce your brand’s environmental impact with bio-based materials. By using renewable sources like
potato or rice starch, you can limit the use of fossil-fuels in the manufacturing process.

Post Consumer Resin (PCR)

Governments and major brands are legislating using more PCR in consumer packaging. We’ll help you
meet this growing demand while maintaining high-quality graphics and performance.

Post Industrial Resin (PIR)

Just like PCR, PIR packaging replaces virgin materials but at an even better price point and a

Conventional

Conventional packing films are proven and cost-effective. They look great, resist punctures,
withstand high temperatures, and provide barrier protection when needed.

# Your Packaging Concierge

At Freedom Packaging, we redefine what it means to be a packaging manufacturer.

More than rigid and flexible packaging, we’re your trusted partner delivering custom packaging
solutions with unparalleled service. As your packaging concierge, we guide you from concept to
delivery, ensuring your brand stands out while meeting your business needs.

 

[Let us assist you][17]

Why Choose Us

## Best-in-Class Service, Every Step of the Way

[two women meeting at a table]

### Seamless Process

Our team makes your packaging process seamless. With up to 180-day warehousing and pay-on-ship
billing, Freedom Packaging aligns with your schedule while reducing inventory carrying costs by up
to 30%. Our min/max inventory management optimizes your supply chain with precision, ensuring you’re
never overstocked or underprepared—keeping operations running smoothly and efficiently every day.

[specs of a package from front, side, back view]

### Innovative Design & Production

Creativity meets functionality at Freedom Packaging. Expert packaging design and graphic design
teams craft visually stunning, practical solutions that elevate your brand. From initial concepts to
prepress, every detail ensures your packaging is print-ready and market-ready with 0.25% defect
rates—four times better than industry standard. With 4-6 week lead times, your vision comes to life
faster.

[trees in a forest]

### Sustainability That Delivers

Committed to a greener future, we offer sustainable packaging solutions that reduce environmental
impact without compromising quality. Free on-site trials let you explore eco-friendly materials and
innovative designs, and test solutions before full-scale production. We empower you to make
responsible choices that resonate with conscious consumers, and have helped customers transition
packaging from 100% landfill to 100% recyclable.

## The Markets We Serve

[frozen food in bowl]

### Frozen Food Packaging

Durable, freezer-safe frozen food packaging designed to protect products while maintaining brand
appeal throughout the cold chain.

[Read More][18]

[person in field holding lettuce ]

### Fresh Food Packaging

Specialized fresh food packaging solutions that keep produce, meats, and dairy fresh, appealing, and
market-ready with sustainable materials and expert design.

[Read More][19]

[pet food in puch]

### Pet Food Packaging

Premium pet food packaging solutions for dog and cat food brands that ensure freshness, enhance
shelf appeal, and build trust with pet owners.

[Read More][20]

[Cannabis Packaging in pouch]

### Cannabis Packaging

Compliant, child-resistant cannabis packaging that protects product integrity while meeting
regulatory requirements and elevating your brand.

[Read More][21]

[Digital flexible packing converters]

### Digital Flexible Packing Converters

High-quality unprinted roll stock designed specifically for digital presses and flexible packaging
converters, delivering reliable results every time.

[Read More][22]

Combining cutting-edge technology, creative expertise, and a customer-first approach, Freedom

14+ years and 99-100% vendor satisfaction scores, our packaging concierge service simplifies your

## A MODERN APPROACH TO SUSTAINABILITY

# When it comes to sustainable packaging, we know one size doesn’t fit all. Explore the largest
# library of stock components to help you make the shift to a more sustainable future.

## **PACKAGING DESIGN**

Choose from one of the world’s largest libraries of stock packaging—or create a truly custom design
of your own.

[Stock][31]
[Custom][32]
[Metals][33]
[Skincare][34]

## **BEAUTY FORMULATIONS**

HCT's R+D team collaborates with the most outstanding labs in Asia, Europe, and North America, to
create exceptional formulas that range from color to skincare. We have a global footprint for
research, development, and formulation, helping clients get to market faster.

[CONTACT US][35]

## **ACCESSORIES**

HCT Accessories specializes in creating premium quality beauty tools and solutions that fall into
the many segments of the cosmetics industry. Choose from a unique library of advanced materials,
customizable finishes, and decorative options.

[Brushes & Applicators][36]
[Beauty Tools][37]
[Cut & Sew][38]
[Eyelashes][39]

## MANUFACTURING

HCT has manufacturing plants worldwide, ensuring excellence in quality and speed to market. We
conduct thorough vetting and Social Compliance Auditing of all factories and trusted partner
vendors. HCT's global footprint makes it easy to source best in class materials and tap into cutting
edge technologies and global cultural influences.

[CONTACT US][40]

## THE HCT PROCESS

### > Concept Development & Design

Our relationship with customers begins with total collaboration – through the development and design
process, our R+D and Sales teams find the best solutions to deliver on your goals. Customers can
choose from our extensive range of existing packaging or work with us to create a completely custom
design. Or take advantage of one of the world’s most comprehensive and evolving stock libraries by
combining our stock component parts with a newly designed custom piece. Our in-house team of expert
designers is unparalleled when it comes to innovative cosmetics packaging. In addition to
specializing in industrial design and engineering, we also offer graphic design, package
brainstorming, formula conceptualization, and formula R+D to tap into the most innovative
technologies and global cultural influences.

### > Manufacturing

We live at the forefront of innovation, delivering packaging and product development coupled with
vertically integrated testing and manufacturing capabilities. HCT controls eight manufacturing
facilities and has strict audit requirements for all vendors. This allows us to deliver exceptional
solutions to clients for cost effectiveness, efficiencies across the board, and regionalization.
Lean on us for the world’s most extensive selection of stock packaging options, or collaborate with
us on custom tooling, custom formulation, shade matching, state-of-the-art decorating and finishing,
and quality control. With a portfolio that expands year over year, the possibilities with HCT Group
are infinite.

### > Fill & Assembly

Flexibility is key when finding the best product for your brand. We provide our customers with the
option to choose formulas from the United States, Italy, China, Korea or Japan. Our fill and
assembly factories provide cost effective and timely solutions for clients.

### > Logistics & Operations

Once we’ve built the product of your dreams, we won’t just walk away. We offer full-service
integrated logistics and operational support to help you get on shelves faster. Our team of experts
can support all aspects of your product launch including organizing US customs/FDA Clearance,
foreign-to-foreign shipping, sea, air, and domestic tracking as well as managing foreign imports and
exports. Because we bring our partners unique, groundbreaking products unlike anything else on the
market, implementing strict testing and compliance is important to us. We offer compatibility
testing, stability testing, regulatory assistance, finished goods QA/QC, and documentation
management and procurement.

## STAY IN TOUCH

Sign up for our mailing list to receive updates about our latest innovations.
* Email*
* * Sign me up to the HCT mailing list to receive the latest news and releases.

## **Top Coolest Headquarters in the World**

Discover the top coolest headquarters and corporate offices in the world—iconic workplaces known for
innovative design, creative architecture, and inspiring office environments. These world-class
company headquarters set new standards for modern corporate office culture, blending functionality
with bold aesthetics to create spaces that employees genuinely enjoy working in every day.

From cutting-edge technology campuses to architecturally stunning corporate offices, these
headquarters showcase how thoughtful design, open collaboration spaces, and employee-focused
amenities can transform the workplace experience. Each headquarters highlights unique approaches to
office layout, sustainability, wellness, and creativity, making them a powerful source of
inspiration for corporate office management teams and business leaders worldwide.

To explore these incredible headquarters in action and see what makes them stand out, watch the
video below for a visual tour of some of the coolest corporate offices in the world:

If you have ever wondered what it would be like to work in a truly inspiring corporate environment,
these headquarters represent the ultimate vision of modern office life. They are not just
offices—they are destinations that reflect company culture, innovation, and forward-thinking
leadership, and they continue to influence how organizations design and manage their headquarters
across the globe.

## **What can you find in a company headquarters?**

In a company headquarters, you will typically find the organization’s leadership team along with its
most critical business functions. These departments and offices work together to manage strategy,
operations, and long-term growth:
* **Chief Executive Officer (CEO) Office** – Responsible for overall vision, leadership, and
  strategic decision-making.
* **Executive Team & Board of Directors** – Oversees corporate governance, policy direction, and
  high-level business objectives.
* **Administration Office** – Handles internal coordination, office management, and organizational
  support functions.
* **Finance, Accounting & Billing Department** – Manages budgets, financial reporting, payroll,
  billing, and compliance.
* **Marketing & Communications Department** – Develops branding, public relations, advertising, and
  internal and external communications.
* **Sales Department** – Drives revenue generation, client acquisition, and business development
  efforts.
* **Customer Service & Support** – Provides assistance to customers, manages inquiries, and resolves
  issues.
* **Research & Development Department** – Focuses on innovation, product development, and improving
  existing services or technologies.
* **Operations & Logistics** – Oversees daily business operations, supply chains, and operational
  efficiency.
* **Human Resources Department** – Manages recruitment, employee relations, benefits, training, and
  workplace policies.
* **Legal Department** – Handles contracts, regulatory compliance, risk management, and legal
  matters affecting the company.

Together, these offices form the operational and strategic core of a company, making the
headquarters the central hub for leadership, planning, and decision-making.

offices—they are destinations that reflect company culture, innovation, and forward-thinking
leadership, and they continue to influence how organizations design and manage their headquarters
across the globe.

## **What can you find in a company headquarters?**

In a company headquarters, you will typically find the organization’s leadership team along with its
most critical business functions. These departments and offices work together to manage strategy,
operations, and long-term growth:
* **Chief Executive Officer (CEO) Office** – Responsible for overall vision, leadership, and
  strategic decision-making.
* **Executive Team & Board of Directors** – Oversees corporate governance, policy direction, and
  high-level business objectives.
* **Administration Office** – Handles internal coordination, office management, and organizational
  support functions.
* **Finance, Accounting & Billing Department** – Manages budgets, financial reporting, payroll,
  billing, and compliance.
* **Marketing & Communications Department** – Develops branding, public relations, advertising, and
  internal and external communications.
* **Sales Department** – Drives revenue generation, client acquisition, and business development
  efforts.
* **Customer Service & Support** – Provides assistance to customers, manages inquiries, and resolves
  issues.
* **Research & Development Department** – Focuses on innovation, product development, and improving
  existing services or technologies.
* **Operations & Logistics** – Oversees daily business operations, supply chains, and operational
  efficiency.
* **Human Resources Department** – Manages recruitment, employee relations, benefits, training, and
  workplace policies.
* **Legal Department** – Handles contracts, regulatory compliance, risk management, and legal
  matters affecting the company.

Together, these offices form the operational and strategic core of a company, making the
headquarters the central hub for leadership, planning, and decision-making.

# We are Inizio.

Empowering health and life sciences companies to transform patients’ lives. 

[Discover what we do][197]

# Four steps to a smarter congress strategy

Transform congresses into connected strategic experiences.

[Download the guidebook][198]

# Blind spots putting your launch at risk?

Discover how InConcert™ brings clarity to launch planning.

[Learn more][199]

# STEM AI.

An AI-powered call recording and analysis solution that transforms real-world HCP interactions into
personalized coaching, actionable insights, and strategic reporting. 

[Discover STEM AI][200]

## Your global Intelligent Commercialization™ partner.

With unmatched scale and scientific expertise, we’re by your side at every stage of the clinical
development and commercialization journey – connecting data, technology, and AI with expert insight
to simplify the complex, unlock value, and realize your product’s potential.

[Learn more][201]

## For every pivotal moment in your product’s lifecycle.

From your earliest breakthroughs to loss of exclusivity, we’ll put an experienced, connected team
right at your fingertips, helping you achieve insight-driven, tech-enabled results at scale.

[Tap to view Discovery]
[Background image for Discovery]

### Discovery

Exploring your opportunities with expert market research and strategy consulting.

[Tap to view Development]
[Background image for Development]

### Development

Advancing your asset through development with integrated scientific strategy, stakeholder
engagement, and communications expertise.

[Tap to view Pre-launch]
[Background image for Pre-launch]

### Pre-launch

Building your evidence base and getting powerful data to pivotal decision-makers.

[Tap to view Launch]
[Background image for Launch]

### Launch

Making maximum impact from day one, with a robust sales and engagement strategy.

[Tap to view Post-launch]
[Background image for Post-launch]

### Post-launch

Driving lasting impact through experiences, medical education, patient services, and analytics.

## Global scale. Proven results.

By maximizing asset value at every opportunity, we drive measurable and lasting results that deliver
value for our clients.

>
experts across 50 countries
PhDs & 800 nurses on your team
>
pharma & biotech clients worldwide
%
of top 20 pharma as clients (WW Rx sales 2025-2027)

## Best-in-class experts, by your side.

Commercialization is a complex journey, which is why we bring you a team of talented experts trusted
by every top 20 pharma company in the world. 

### Deep, broad expertise.

With unmatched scale and scientific understanding, we pair multidisciplinary human expertise with AI
innovation to get life-changing products to patients faster.

### Solutions to every challenge.

We start with the challenges you face, creating tailored solutions powered by proprietary tech that
deliver exactly the support you need, every step of the way.

### People you’ll love working with.

We build real, lasting partnerships through a single point of contact, a dedicated account team,
rigorous governance, and seamless project delivery.

### Innovation that underpins everything.

We combine proprietary technology, AI, and human insight to deliver Intelligent Commercialization™ –
accelerating lasting impact for you and your patients.

[Get in touch][202]

## Specialized expertise,
## seamlessly connected.

Each of our five industry-leading businesses brings a deep and broad set of capabilities. Work with
one, several, or all – in the way that best supports your goals.

## About DELE

Our company adheres to the "people-oriented" philosophy and the purpose of "quality and integrity"
to serve our customers. 

Our company has become one of the leading companies in the national non-woven fabric processing
equipment industry. 

We are a high-tech enterprise specializing in the research, development, manufacturing and sales of
non-woven fabric processing equipment. 
* Jiangxi Dele Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd. was established in 2010.
* The company now is located in Dexing High-tech Industrial Park, with a total investment of about
  150 million RMB.
* The total land of factory around 50 acres, a plant area of workshop more than 30, 000 square
  meters.
* We have 12 standard production workshops, equipped with CNC machining workshops, spare parts
  warehouses, and assembly Production workshop, etc.

## About DELE

Our company adheres to the "people-oriented" philosophy and the purpose of "quality and integrity"
to serve our customers. 

Our company has become one of the leading companies in the national non-woven fabric processing
equipment industry. 

We are a high-tech enterprise specializing in the research, development, manufacturing and sales of
non-woven fabric processing equipment. 
* Jiangxi Dele Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd. was established in 2010.
* The company now is located in Dexing High-tech Industrial Park, with a total investment of about
  150 million RMB.
* The total land of factory around 50 acres, a plant area of workshop more than 30, 000 square
  meters.
* We have 12 standard production workshops, equipped with CNC machining workshops, spare parts
  warehouses, and assembly Production workshop, etc.

# Imagine What’s Possible.

Packaging Solutions That Drive Product Success
[Talk With Us][64]

## Premium Packaging That Powers Growth

K1 designs premium packaging solutions that elevate brand appeal, boost sales, and build customer
loyalty. For brands seeking a bold, competitive edge with impactful results, we’re here to make it
happen.

## The Total Package

From concept and creation to fulfillment and logistics, our holistic support empowers you to design
without limits.

## Made in the USA

With three U.S. manufacturing facilities and a global supply chain, we are a complete partner you
can rely on as you grow.

## Decades of Excellence

With over 30 years of experience, our team is dedicated to bringing your vision to life with quality
you can trust.

[advent calendar packaging from Neiman Marcus]

**We Are Partners, Not Just Suppliers** K1 Packaging delivers a comprehensive suite of services
designed to ensure seamless, high-quality packaging that aligns perfectly with your unique vision.
We work closely with your team from initial packaging design concept to final delivery, ensuring
that every step of the packaging process is handled with precision, creativity, and attention to
detail.

THE K1 LEGACY

### Over 30 Years of Expertise

K1 has grown from humble beginnings into a global leader with comprehensive packaging manufacture
capabilities and a rich body of expertise.
[Learn About K1][65]
[exterior shot of the k1 packaging group facility]
[yay day digestive supplement packaging]
Industries

### Markets We Serve

K1 Packaging serves a diverse range of markets, positioning your products as the preferred choice
for consumers.

[EXPLORE OUR MARKETS][66]
[an image showing product kit packaging for fly by jing]

**Beauty & Personal Care, Health & Wellness, Food, Dietary & Nutraceuticals, and Consumer Products**
K1 caters to many industries, providing versatile, premium packaging that stands out while aligning
with brand values and functional needs.

Products

### Premium Packaging Solutions

K1 Packaging provides a complete suite of services, from design to fulfillment. Let us handle the
complexities of product packaging engineering so you can focus on growing your business.

## Creating experiences through packaging.

# Welcome to
# Merchant Boxes.

[Hands working on product design sketches and blueprints spread across a table, with model boxes and
design tools around.]

## If you can imagine it, we can make it.

Packaging can be a major brand differentiator. Merchant Boxes is a partner for brands and
organizations large and small that want to get the most out of their packaging and in-home brand
experiences.

We design and supply the highest **quality** **packaging**, through one of the **largest global
sourcing networks** on the planet, designing, sourcing, and producing impactful **brand
experiences**.

# Custom Packaging

# Custom Packaging

[Packaging design for a natural cosmetics brand, featuring a teal-colored box with a white leaf logo
and text that reads 'Your Brand, All Natural,' placed on a gold tray. There are two tubes of similar
design and some grey-green leaves around the tray on a white surface.]

Custom packaging isn't just about aesthetics; it's a strategic tool that impacts customer
perception, loyalty, and business growth.

1. **First Impressions Matter**: Just like meeting someone new, the first impression you make with
your product matters. Within seconds, customers form opinions about your brand. Imagine delivering
your product in a plain, unbranded box—what does that say about your brand? Consistent,
well-designed custom packaging reinforces your brand identity and sets the stage for a positive
experience.

2. **Reinforces Your Brand**: Custom packaging is often the first touchpoint outside of your
website. It reaffirms why customers chose your product in the first place. By bringing your unique
selling proposition onto your packaging, you signal to customers that they should buy from you
again. It's a way to say, "This is us, and we're worth coming back to!"

3. **Differentiation**: In a sea of generic packaging, customized packaging allows your brand to
stand out. It differentiates your product from competitors and highlights its advantages. When
customers see your distinct packaging, they associate it with your brand and remember you more
readily.

4. **Enhances Customer Experience**: Custom packaging contributes to the overall customer journey.
It's not just about the product—it's about the entire experience. If you've invested in a seamless
online experience, don't let it fall flat with lackluster packaging. Consistency matters and custom
packaging ensures that your brand story continues beyond the website.

5. **Marketing and Branding**: Tailoring packaging to your unique needs strengthens your connection
with customers. It's an essential element of modern marketing. When done right, it communicates
quality, care, and attention to detail. Remember, your packaging speaks volumes about your brand!

## The **data **on custom packaging **speaks** for itself.

**72%**

[Close-up of a black and white guitar with an electric guitar body, strings, and tuning pegs
visible.]

In the US alone, [72% of consumers][35] make purchasing decisions based on packaging design.

**70%**

[Forbes logo in black text on a transparent background]

[60–80% of consumers][36] do not go back to the same business even if they were satisfied with the
product. If there is no experience, no “wow” factor in their wider product experience.

**61%**

[A computer monitor displaying a graph, a keyboard, and a mouse on a desk]

[61% of consumers ][37]say they are much more likely to repeat a purchase of a luxury product if it
came in premium packaging.

**52%**

[Empty black background with a white arrow pointing left.]

[52% of consumers][38] have changed product brands to new packaging designs.

[Graphic design promoting the Package Design Podcast, sponsored by Merchant Boxes, featuring bold
black text 'unboxed' over a blue and white geometric background.]

The Unboxed Podcast is a space for conversation about brand experiences, the challenges and wins
across industries and product types, and the impactful additional brand experiences and affinity
created through custom-branded packaging and beyond. Whether you are a startup founder looking to
expand your brand's reach, a marketing professional looking for some tips, or an enterprise

## Creating experiences through packaging.

# Welcome to
# Merchant Boxes.

[Hands working on product design sketches and blueprints spread across a table, with model boxes and
design tools around.]

## If you can imagine it, we can make it.

Packaging can be a major brand differentiator. Merchant Boxes is a partner for brands and
organizations large and small that want to get the most out of their packaging and in-home brand
experiences.

We design and supply the highest **quality** **packaging**, through one of the **largest global
sourcing networks** on the planet, designing, sourcing, and producing impactful **brand
experiences**.

# Custom Packaging

# Custom Packaging

[Packaging design for a natural cosmetics brand, featuring a teal-colored box with a white leaf logo
and text that reads 'Your Brand, All Natural,' placed on a gold tray. There are two tubes of similar
design and some grey-green leaves around the tray on a white surface.]

Custom packaging isn't just about aesthetics; it's a strategic tool that impacts customer
perception, loyalty, and business growth.

1. **First Impressions Matter**: Just like meeting someone new, the first impression you make with
your product matters. Within seconds, customers form opinions about your brand. Imagine delivering
your product in a plain, unbranded box—what does that say about your brand? Consistent,
well-designed custom packaging reinforces your brand identity and sets the stage for a positive
experience.

2. **Reinforces Your Brand**: Custom packaging is often the first touchpoint outside of your
website. It reaffirms why customers chose your product in the first place. By bringing your unique
selling proposition onto your packaging, you signal to customers that they should buy from you
again. It's a way to say, "This is us, and we're worth coming back to!"

3. **Differentiation**: In a sea of generic packaging, customized packaging allows your brand to
stand out. It differentiates your product from competitors and highlights its advantages. When
customers see your distinct packaging, they associate it with your brand and remember you more
readily.

4. **Enhances Customer Experience**: Custom packaging contributes to the overall customer journey.
It's not just about the product—it's about the entire experience. If you've invested in a seamless
online experience, don't let it fall flat with lackluster packaging. Consistency matters and custom
packaging ensures that your brand story continues beyond the website.

5. **Marketing and Branding**: Tailoring packaging to your unique needs strengthens your connection
with customers. It's an essential element of modern marketing. When done right, it communicates
quality, care, and attention to detail. Remember, your packaging speaks volumes about your brand!

## The **data **on custom packaging **speaks** for itself.

**72%**

[Close-up of a black and white guitar with an electric guitar body, strings, and tuning pegs
visible.]

In the US alone, [72% of consumers][35] make purchasing decisions based on packaging design.

**70%**

[Forbes logo in black text on a transparent background]

[60–80% of consumers][36] do not go back to the same business even if they were satisfied with the
product. If there is no experience, no “wow” factor in their wider product experience.

**61%**

[A computer monitor displaying a graph, a keyboard, and a mouse on a desk]

[61% of consumers ][37]say they are much more likely to repeat a purchase of a luxury product if it
came in premium packaging.

**52%**

[Empty black background with a white arrow pointing left.]

[52% of consumers][38] have changed product brands to new packaging designs.

[Graphic design promoting the Package Design Podcast, sponsored by Merchant Boxes, featuring bold
black text 'unboxed' over a blue and white geometric background.]

## Merchant Boxes is a proud sponsor of the **Unboxed Podcast**.

The Unboxed Podcast is a space for conversation about brand experiences, the challenges and wins
across industries and product types, and the impactful additional brand experiences and affinity
created through custom-branded packaging and beyond. Whether you are a startup founder looking to
expand your brand's reach, a marketing professional looking for some tips, or an enterprise
executive looking for inspiration from industry leaders, we have an episode for you.
