products and essential services across multiple industries. Our operations span plastic packaging
manufacturing, table water production, bulk water supply and bakery products. We are dedicated to
providing reliable solutions, maintaining high production standards and ensuring customer
satisfaction in every area of our business.

Premium nylon packaging, sachet water nylon, customized printing and industrial plastic products.

Hygienically packaged drinking water produced to meet the highest quality standards.

🥖

Fresh bread, pastries and other baked products prepared daily for homes and businesses.

Reliable supply of clean water to homes, estates, offices and commercial facilities.

Strong and hygienic nylon packaging specially designed for bakeries, with custom printing and
branding options available.

High-quality pure water film manufactured for durability, excellent sealing and safe water
packaging.

Durable plastic containers and jerry cans suitable for water storage, transportation and
distribution.

### Nylon Packaging Bags

Shopping bags, carrier bags and packaging materials for retail, commercial and industrial
applications.

Custom branding, logo printing and personalized packaging solutions for businesses and

### Industrial Plastic Products

A wide range of commercial and industrial plastic materials manufactured to meet various business
needs.

### Table Water Production

Production and distribution of clean, hygienically packaged drinking water for homes, offices,
events and businesses.

### Bulk Water Supply

Supply of treated water to storage tanks, residential estates, construction sites, factories and
commercial facilities.

### Bakery Products

Freshly baked bread, pastries and other quality bakery products prepared using modern production

## Products

## Our Custom Packaging Solutions

Our custom products are designed to streamline your production, elevate your presentation, and meet
the strictest quality standards.

## SOFT-CEL® Candy Pads

Protect delicate confections with decorative, multi-ply pads available in custom shapes, colors, and
ply options—engineered for both function and elegance.

[View More Details][33]

## SOFT-CEL® Cushioning

Eco-friendly padding made from recycled materials, providing soft yet strong protection for a wide
range of food and retail products.

[View More Details][34]

## Folding Cartons

Durable, brand-ready cartons designed for product protection and shelf appeal—customized to your
dimensions, printing, and finishing needs.

[View More Details][35]

## Paperboard Trays

Precision die-cut trays that offer structural support for packaging inserts or displays – custom
built for stability, presentation and superior machinability.

[View More Details][36]

## Slit Roll Stock

High-performance slit rollstock engineered for automated lines – available in coated or uncoated
paperboard and ideal for use as base cards, U-boards, or layers across a range of packaging
applications.

[View More Details][37]

## “U” Boards, Base Cards & Layers

U-boards, Base Cards and Layer Boards cut with precision and consistency. Available in virgin or
recycled and with coated or uncoated finishes to best suit your product and production needs.

[View More Details][38]

## Specialty Paper

FDA-approved glassine, parchment, and Quilon papers tailored for food-safe use and available in
custom sizes and finishes.

[View More Details][39]

## Candy Cups, Wax Paper & Assembled Partitions

Everything you need to separate, protect, and present your confections—from individual cups to wax
liners and hand-assembled partitions.

[View More Details][40]

## Inserts and Dividers

Custom die-cut inserts and dividers that organize and protect products within their packaging—ideal
for gift sets, retail kits, and fragile items.

[View More Details][41]

## INNOVATION

## Introducing Recycled SOFT-CEL Cushioning

Our newest advancement brings performance and sustainability together. Designed with both product
protection and environmental impact in mind, this next-generation cushioning solution is crafted
from recycled materials—without compromising softness, strength, or quality.

[Markets We Impact][42]

## SUSTAINABILITY

## Responsible Packaging
## for a Better Tomorrow

At Murnane, sustainability isn’t a trend—it’s a long-term commitment. We prioritize recyclable
materials, reduce waste across our manufacturing process, and design packaging that supports a
circular economy.

[CONTACT US][43]

## Who We Are

## Four Generations
## One Purpose

Rooted in over a century of family-owned innovation, we are a packaging partner built on trust,
craftsmanship, and a relentless commitment to quality and service. From food-safe solutions to
high-performance products, our legacy drives everything we do.

[Read Our Story][44]

for gift sets, retail kits, and fragile items.

# Common Questions About NAPCO Custom Packaging

##### What is your minimum order quantity?

NAPCO offers flexible minimums starting at just 1 unit for digital manufacturing and 5,000+ units
for traditional production. Unlike many packaging manufacturers, we removed the ceiling – not just
the floor.

##### How long does custom packaging take to produce?

Timeline depends on quantity and complexity:
• Prototyping and short run digital production (up to 5,000 units): 7 business days-3 weeks
• Traditional production (5,000+ units): 4-6 weeks

Request a quote for your specific project timeline.

**These timelines are based on current capacity, and we will update as that capacity changes
throughout the year.*

##### Do you offer packaging prototypes and samples?

Yes. NAPCO provides custom packaging prototypes and samples to validate design, structure, and
quality before full production. We offer both unprinted structural samples and digitally printed
samples with actual graphics.

##### What's the difference between digital and traditional packaging printing?

**Digital printing: **Best for 250-5,000 units, faster setup, no physical plates needed – perfect
for testing and short runs
**Traditional printing: **Best for 5,000+ units, more cost-efficient at scale – ideal for proven
products

NAPCO offers both, so you start with digital and seamlessly scale to traditional with the same
partner.

##### What industries do you serve?

NAPCO serves brands across industries including trading card games, vinyl records, wine & spirits,
healthcare, subscription boxes, cosmetics & beauty, and more.

##### Are you a US-based packaging manufacturer?

Yes. NAPCO is a family-owned packaging manufacturer based in Sparta, North Carolina. We’ve been
manufacturing custom packaging in the USA since 1977, offering responsive service, domestic
production, and reliable partnerships. 

##### Can NAPCO handle large-scale production runs?

Yes. NAPCO offers both digital manufacturing (up to 5,000 units) and traditional production for
larger runs — with no upper limit on volume. Brands can start with a 50-unit prototype and scale to
hundreds of thousands of units without ever switching vendors. That dual capability under one roof
is something less than 1% of the packaging industry can offer.

Introducing Packagingdotcom, your trusted partner in innovative packaging solutions. With a rich

Packagingdotcom, founded with a vision to transform packaging, has grown into a leader, delivering

## Discover Everything You Need to Know.

###### What products does Packagingdotcom offer?

At Packagingdotcom, we offer a wide range of packaging solutions, including packaging materials such
as corrugated boxes, custom-printed boxes, paper bags, and wrapping paper. Additionally, we provide
various packaging products like custom displays, inserts, and specialty packaging tailored to your
unique requirements.

###### Can I request a custom packaging design?

Absolutely! We take pride in offering personalized packaging solutions. Whether you need a unique
design, specific dimensions, or branded packaging, our team of experts will work closely with you to

# **Founded in 1975, Packaging Personified is a leader in the flexible packaging industry.**

## Our Story

In 1975, our founders Dominic Imburgia and Phyllis Muccianti sat at a kitchen table and created a
flexible packaging business. After leaving Sears, they used their packaging experience to coordinate
and procure flexible packaging for third-party use. As entrepreneurs, and firm believers in quality
and service, they began their business at that same kitchen table. Within four months, their
business needed more room to grow.

[ Learn More ][34]
[DANIEL KELLEGHAN PHOTOGRAPHY-5492.jpg]

## Capabilities

Since our founding in 1975 our capabilities have expanded each year. Our goal of vertical
integration has provided us with the ability to better manage quality, service and cost relative to
our competitors.

[Learn More][35]
 
[_CCC4499.jpg]

## Products

Packaging Personified serves industry leaders with our flexible packaging, graphics proofing and
separation, extrusion, printing, converting, lamination, and laser perforation, all done from our
multiple manufacturing locations in the center of the United States. Our custom packaging has
continuously proven, over decades, to be superior in quality and price. By working directly with our
clients, we understand your specific needs and expectations. Whether large or small, we have the
flexibility to handle your packaging needs.

[Learn More][36]
 

## Contact

Feel free to contact us with any questions.

# **Founded in 1975, Packaging Personified is a leader in the flexible packaging industry.**

## Our Story

In 1975, our founders Dominic Imburgia and Phyllis Muccianti sat at a kitchen table and created a
flexible packaging business. After leaving Sears, they used their packaging experience to coordinate
and procure flexible packaging for third-party use. As entrepreneurs, and firm believers in quality
and service, they began their business at that same kitchen table. Within four months, their
business needed more room to grow.

[ Learn More ][34]
[DANIEL KELLEGHAN PHOTOGRAPHY-5492.jpg]

## Capabilities

Since our founding in 1975 our capabilities have expanded each year. Our goal of vertical
integration has provided us with the ability to better manage quality, service and cost relative to
our competitors.

[Learn More][35]
 
[_CCC4499.jpg]

## Products

Packaging Personified serves industry leaders with our flexible packaging, graphics proofing and
separation, extrusion, printing, converting, lamination, and laser perforation, all done from our
multiple manufacturing locations in the center of the United States. Our custom packaging has
continuously proven, over decades, to be superior in quality and price. By working directly with our
clients, we understand your specific needs and expectations. Whether large or small, we have the
flexibility to handle your packaging needs.

[Learn More][36]

  [question mark icon] Top FAQs [Explore all FAQs][7]
  * What happens after I place my order? Do I get a proof before printing?
    
    After checkout, our dedicated Prepress team will review your design for any technical concerns
    and send a 2D digital proof of your custom boxes to your email within 24 hours. If any changes
    need to be made, you can send a note directly to our Prepress team through the proof page and
    they'll be happy to help with finalizing your design for printing.
  * How do I know if my art is printable?
    
    Our dedicated in-house Prepress team will review your custom box design for any technical
    concerns (artwork resolution, blurriness, splits, thin lines, and bleeds) and if found, will
    note them for your attention in the proof. If you're unsure of how to fix any printing concerns
    that are noted, our Prepress representatives are happy to help you through the process. It's
    important to keep in mind that our team does not check for spelling or grammar errors, nor do
    they provide any subjective feedback on design content.
  * What is the turnaround time on my order?
    
    Our Standard turnaround for most custom packaging orders is around 10 business days and Rush
    turnaround is 7 business days. These turnarounds do not include transit time (1 - 7 business
    days depending on your location). Special custom or bulk orders may require a few extra days to
    get setup and produced. Please note that during extremely busy times of year some orders may
    take longer to complete. While delivery estimates cannot be guaranteed, all dates shown at
    checkout are the quickest estimate we offer. If your delivery date is time sensitive, we highly
    recommend choosing Rush production and expedited shipping for your box orders.
  * Can I get an instant quote for my order?
    
    Yes, you can select your size, material, and quantity on our free 3D design tool to instantly
    view a quote for your project. As you upload artwork, add text, or color the background in each
    panel of the 3D model, you'll see your Unit Price update in real-time.
  * Can you print inside the boxes?
    
    Yes! We can print on the inside of any of our corrugated box styles. This includes Mailers,
    Shipping Boxes, and Tuck Tops (our secret menu product!). Product Boxes are currently limited to
    printing on the exterior only. You can even use our online box designer to design the inside of
    your custom boxes. For Shippers and Tuck Tops, we currently require a 2D dieline template be
    submitted for both the interior and exterior so we can set up your order as a custom order. You
    can also submit designs this way for our Mailer boxes, if you prefer to build on a 2D
    Illustrator template instead of our free 3D box design tool.
  * How to get a dieline?
    
    If you prefer to work in 2D to create your design in Adobe Illustrator (or another tool outside
    of our website), we recommend using a dieline template. For corrugated and cardstock boxes, you
    can download a free template from the artwork upload page or within our online design studio.
    For our other products, dielines are available for download from the template section of the
    product detail page.

Select a packaging style, quantity, and choose from custom or stock sizes – then start designing

    After checkout, our dedicated Prepress team will review your design for any technical concerns

    need to be made, you can send a note directly to our Prepress team through the proof page and
    they'll be happy to help with finalizing your design for printing.
  * How do I know if my art is printable?
    
    Our dedicated in-house Prepress team will review your custom box design for any technical
    concerns (artwork resolution, blurriness, splits, thin lines, and bleeds) and if found, will
    note them for your attention in the proof. If you're unsure of how to fix any printing concerns
    that are noted, our Prepress representatives are happy to help you through the process. It's
    important to keep in mind that our team does not check for spelling or grammar errors, nor do
    they provide any subjective feedback on design content.
  * What is the turnaround time on my order?
    
    Our Standard turnaround for most custom packaging orders is around 10 business days and Rush
    turnaround is 7 business days. These turnarounds do not include transit time (1 - 7 business
    days depending on your location). Special custom or bulk orders may require a few extra days to
    get setup and produced. Please note that during extremely busy times of year some orders may
    take longer to complete. While delivery estimates cannot be guaranteed, all dates shown at
    checkout are the quickest estimate we offer. If your delivery date is time sensitive, we highly
    recommend choosing Rush production and expedited shipping for your box orders.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: How to Order Custom Boxes With Packola.com?
A:

Here's a step-by-step guide on how to order your custom boxes from Packola.com. 

Q: Do you offer Free Samples?
A:

We do not offer free samples or material kits at this time. You can, however, order 1 sample of
almost any of our boxes. 

 

Pick your product, select a quantity of "1 Sample", design your box, and check out!  Custom samples
are the best way to know the box is the right fit for your product.

Q: I am a reseller. Can you waive my sales taxes?
A:

Yes, however, we need you to submit your resale certificate before placing your order. We have
limited ability to refund sales taxes after an order is placed.

Q: How can I create my design?
A:

We have an Online Design Studio that makes it super easy to add logo, text, and graphics to your box
within minutes. You can also use a professional desktop application like Adobe Illustrator® and send
us the completed artwork. Already have a file but have questions about your design? Email our
packaging experts at artwork@packola.com for a review.

Q: Do you provide proofs before production?
A:

Yes, we offer free PDF proofs for review that you’ll receive within 24 business hours. Note that
production turnaround doesn’t start until your artwork is approved, and to help avoid delays we will
bypass your approval 3 business days after generating your proof if we haven’t yet received your
feedback or approval.

Q: Do you charge extra based on the number of colors and ink coverage?
A:

We don't add fees for ink coverage or the number of colors on digital prints. Our products come in a
variety of color options to suit different needs. Plus, with Packola, you see the total price
immediately with our real-time pricing.

Q: Do you charge for plates and dies? Are there any hidden costs?
A:

No. There are no hidden fees of any kind. What you see is what you pay.

Q: Where are your products manufactured?
A:

We manufacture all our products in the United States. Based on the order specifications and shipping
ZIP code, we pick a facility that yields the best result.

Q: Do you check my artwork for technical issues like alignment and image resolution?
A:

Yes. We inspect all artwork to ensure it is perfect for printing during the proofing process. If we
find a problem, we will fix it or contact you for further instructions. Your proof will come with
all corrections and edits for transparency. However, we will not be responsible for misspellings or
incorrect content once printing begins.

Q: How can I reorder?
A:

Simply go to Your Account and click on the REORDER button next to your desired item. Proceed to
checkout and place your order.

Q: What is the difference between Shipping, Product, and Mailer boxes?
A:

Shipping boxes -

   **•** Also known as Regular Slotted Containers,

   **•** Sturdy, efficient, and reliable packaging that holds and protects products during transit.

Mailer boxes - 

   **• **Commonly used for subscription shipments and serve a similar purpose to shipping boxes.

   **• **Offer enhanced protection and have a more elegant style, making for a fun unboxing
experience.

Product boxes -

   **• **Retail packaging for products displayed on store shelves.

   **• **Often made of cardstock or paperboard and have attractive designs that grab attention.

We highly recommend using shipping boxes or mailers for product shipping and delivery. We do not
encourage shipping a product using a product box alone.

Q: Why can’t we print on the hidden areas of the box?
A:

The hidden areas of the box, or areas that won’t be seen once the box is assembled, are typically
reserved for production markings, quality control, and other manufacturing purposes that ensure your
boxes look great.

Q: Can you ship to Canada and other US Territories?
A:

Yes. We ship to Canada (taxes and duties not included). We also offer parcel shipping to Puerto
Rico.

Q: Can we use our own shipping account?
A:

Currently, we only support using your own shipping account for FedEx or UPS.

 

If you’d like to use your account, you’ll need to provide the following details to our team:

**   •** Account number

**   • **Billing ZIP code

**   • **Full billing address associated with the account

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: How to Order Custom Boxes With Packola.com?
A:

Here's a step-by-step guide on how to order your custom boxes from Packola.com. 

Q: Do you offer Free Samples?
A:

We do not offer free samples or material kits at this time. You can, however, order 1 sample of
almost any of our boxes. 

 

Pick your product, select a quantity of "1 Sample", design your box, and check out!  Custom samples
are the best way to know the box is the right fit for your product.

Q: I am a reseller. Can you waive my sales taxes?
A:

Yes, however, we need you to submit your resale certificate before placing your order. We have
limited ability to refund sales taxes after an order is placed.

Q: How can I create my design?
A:

We have an Online Design Studio that makes it super easy to add logo, text, and graphics to your box
within minutes. You can also use a professional desktop application like Adobe Illustrator® and send
us the completed artwork. Already have a file but have questions about your design? Email our
packaging experts at artwork@packola.com for a review.

Q: Do you provide proofs before production?
A:

Yes, we offer free PDF proofs for review that you’ll receive within 24 business hours. Note that
production turnaround doesn’t start until your artwork is approved, and to help avoid delays we will
bypass your approval 3 business days after generating your proof if we haven’t yet received your
feedback or approval.

Q: Do you charge extra based on the number of colors and ink coverage?
A:

We don't add fees for ink coverage or the number of colors on digital prints. Our products come in a
variety of color options to suit different needs. Plus, with Packola, you see the total price
immediately with our real-time pricing.

Q: Do you charge for plates and dies? Are there any hidden costs?
A:

No. There are no hidden fees of any kind. What you see is what you pay.

Q: Where are your products manufactured?
A:

We manufacture all our products in the United States. Based on the order specifications and shipping
ZIP code, we pick a facility that yields the best result.

Q: Do you check my artwork for technical issues like alignment and image resolution?
A:

Yes. We inspect all artwork to ensure it is perfect for printing during the proofing process. If we
find a problem, we will fix it or contact you for further instructions. Your proof will come with
all corrections and edits for transparency. However, we will not be responsible for misspellings or
incorrect content once printing begins.

Q: How can I reorder?
A:

Simply go to Your Account and click on the REORDER button next to your desired item. Proceed to
checkout and place your order.

Q: What is the difference between Shipping, Product, and Mailer boxes?
A:

Shipping boxes -

   **•** Also known as Regular Slotted Containers,

   **•** Sturdy, efficient, and reliable packaging that holds and protects products during transit.

Mailer boxes - 

   **• **Commonly used for subscription shipments and serve a similar purpose to shipping boxes.

   **• **Offer enhanced protection and have a more elegant style, making for a fun unboxing
experience.

Product boxes -

   **• **Retail packaging for products displayed on store shelves.

   **• **Often made of cardstock or paperboard and have attractive designs that grab attention.

We highly recommend using shipping boxes or mailers for product shipping and delivery. We do not
encourage shipping a product using a product box alone.

Q: Why can’t we print on the hidden areas of the box?
A:

The hidden areas of the box, or areas that won’t be seen once the box is assembled, are typically
reserved for production markings, quality control, and other manufacturing purposes that ensure your
boxes look great.

Q: Can you ship to Canada and other US Territories?
A:

Yes. We ship to Canada (taxes and duties not included). We also offer parcel shipping to Puerto
Rico.

Q: Can we use our own shipping account?
A:

Currently, we only support using your own shipping account for FedEx or UPS.

 

If you’d like to use your account, you’ll need to provide the following details to our team:

**   •** Account number

**   • **Billing ZIP code

**   • **Full billing address associated with the account

#### [Plywood Cases][75]

Our plywood cases offer a strong, lightweight, and cost-effective solution for protecting goods
during transport or export. Designed and manufactured to suit your exact requirements, they provide
excellent durability while keeping overall shipping weight to a minimum. Ideal for air, sea, and
road freight, our plywood cases can be fully customised with internal fittings, foam inserts, or
pallet bases for complete product protection.

[View Product][76]

#### [Heavy Duty Corrugated][77]

Our heavy duty corrugated packaging is built to protect and transport goods of all shapes and sizes,
whether for use across the UK or for export. We design and manufacture everything from simple layer
pads to complex die-cut solutions, ensuring a precise fit for your products. Options include
reinforced inserts for added protection, and pallet box combinations for easier storage, handling,
and shipment.

#### [Pallet Wrap and Strapping][79]

wrap and strapping solutions. Designed for strength, stability and ease of use, they are the ideal

[Plywood Pallet Packaging]

#### [Plywood Cases][75]

Our plywood cases offer a strong, lightweight, and cost-effective solution for protecting goods
during transport or export. Designed and manufactured to suit your exact requirements, they provide
excellent durability while keeping overall shipping weight to a minimum. Ideal for air, sea, and
road freight, our plywood cases can be fully customised with internal fittings, foam inserts, or
pallet bases for complete product protection.

[View Product][76]

#### [Heavy Duty Corrugated][77]

Our heavy duty corrugated packaging is built to protect and transport goods of all shapes and sizes,
whether for use across the UK or for export. We design and manufacture everything from simple layer
pads to complex die-cut solutions, ensuring a precise fit for your products. Options include
reinforced inserts for added protection, and pallet box combinations for easier storage, handling,
and shipment.

[View Product][78]
[Pallet Wrapping and Strapping]

#### [Pallet Wrap and Strapping][79]

Ensure your pallets stay secure and protected during storage and transport with our premium pallet
wrap and strapping solutions. Designed for strength, stability and ease of use, they are the ideal
choice for any pallet based shipment.

[View Product][80]

## Delivering on ***Our Word***

Walking the Walk For Over 50 Years

Founded in Atlanta, Georgia by Frank Pritchard in 1972 as a manufacturer of protective packaging
products, Pak-Lite, Inc. has embarked on a progressive path of product diversification and enhanced
capabilities. Guiding them to the position of a leading North American converter/manufacturer of
US-sourced foams, rubber, nonwovens, foils, films, and specialty materials. Our customer base
includes many of the top OEM and industrial companies in the world.

[Connect with Us][20]

## **Why choose** Pak-Lite, Inc? 
## Because We **Manufacture Success**

PLI has manufacturing facilities in GA, NC, and Taiwan. We have over 300+ dedicated professionals
committed to making your project a success before, during, and after the design and manufacturing of
your product. We will help you select the best, sustainable materials for your specific application.
Join our customer base, which already includes many of the top OEM and industrial companies in the
world.

[Why We're Different][21]

## Certified to Meet **Your Manufacturing Needs**

[See Our Certifications][22]

## ***Global**
## Manufacturing Capabilities*

Our manufacturing capabilities include extrusion lamination to foams and rubber substrates. We
combine materials to composite form and then supply you with die-cut parts, components, roll stock,
or sheeting. Finished parts often include pressure-sensitive adhesives and release liners.
Additional capabilities include material selection, prototyping, skiving/slitting, rotary/flatbed
die cutting, kiss cutting, spooling, precision parts manufacturing, assembly, and much more.

[Lab][23]

## Material ***Fabrication***

We are ISO 9001:2015 and IATF 16949 certified with a wide selection of capabilities in converting
foams, rubbers, and nonwoven fabrics for the OEMs and Tier 1 automotive industry. PLI will assist
you in designing the exact components to meet your demanding specifications. We have extensive
experience with 3M Adhesives and Avery Adhesives as well as years of sourcing the top foam, rubber,
polymer, packaging, nonwoven, and fiber and film suppliers worldwide.

## Delivering on ***Our Word***

Walking the Walk For Over 50 Years

Founded in Atlanta, Georgia by Frank Pritchard in 1972 as a manufacturer of protective packaging
products, Pak-Lite, Inc. has embarked on a progressive path of product diversification and enhanced
capabilities. Guiding them to the position of a leading North American converter/manufacturer of
US-sourced foams, rubber, nonwovens, foils, films, and specialty materials. Our customer base
includes many of the top OEM and industrial companies in the world.

[Connect with Us][20]

## **Why choose** Pak-Lite, Inc? 
## Because We **Manufacture Success**

PLI has manufacturing facilities in GA, NC, and Taiwan. We have over 300+ dedicated professionals
committed to making your project a success before, during, and after the design and manufacturing of
your product. We will help you select the best, sustainable materials for your specific application.
Join our customer base, which already includes many of the top OEM and industrial companies in the
world.

[Why We're Different][21]

## Certified to Meet **Your Manufacturing Needs**

[See Our Certifications][22]

## ***Global**
## Manufacturing Capabilities*

Our manufacturing capabilities include extrusion lamination to foams and rubber substrates. We
combine materials to composite form and then supply you with die-cut parts, components, roll stock,
or sheeting. Finished parts often include pressure-sensitive adhesives and release liners.
Additional capabilities include material selection, prototyping, skiving/slitting, rotary/flatbed
die cutting, kiss cutting, spooling, precision parts manufacturing, assembly, and much more.

[Lab][23]

## Material ***Fabrication***

We are ISO 9001:2015 and IATF 16949 certified with a wide selection of capabilities in converting
foams, rubbers, and nonwoven fabrics for the OEMs and Tier 1 automotive industry. PLI will assist
you in designing the exact components to meet your demanding specifications. We have extensive
experience with 3M Adhesives and Avery Adhesives as well as years of sourcing the top foam, rubber,
polymer, packaging, nonwoven, and fiber and film suppliers worldwide.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What is Remaker AI?

+

Remaker AI is an AI-powered creative platform with AI image editing as its core feature. It provides
powerful image processing tools that allow users to easily perform photo restoration, background
removal, style transfer, image upscaling, and more. Additionally, Remaker AI includes AI video
generation and a rich library of trending entertainment templates, helping users quickly create
viral short videos, Reels, TikToks, and YouTube Shorts. Whether for individual creators or
enterprise teams, Remaker AI significantly boosts creative efficiency and delivers
professional-grade results.

### How does Remaker AI help improve content creation efficiency?

+

Remaker AI offers a full suite of intelligent tools that can automatically generate and process
images or videos based on simple user inputs. This dramatically saves time while significantly
improving content quality, making it suitable for all industries and creative scenarios.

### Do I need technical knowledge to use Remaker AI?

+

No technical knowledge is required. Remaker AI features a clean and intuitive interface that anyone
can pick up instantly. Every tool page also includes detailed step-by-step tutorials to help users
get started quickly.

### Does Remaker AI support multilingual content generation?

+

Yes. Remaker AI supports content generation in multiple languages including English, Chinese,
Japanese, German, and many others, allowing users worldwide to create high-quality assets in their
preferred language.

### How much does Remaker AI cost?

+

Remaker AI offers flexible credit-based plans ranging from $5.99 for 200 credits to $299 for 20,000
credits. Users can choose the package that best fits their needs. Many basic features are also
available for free.

### Does Remaker AI offer free credits or a free trial?

+

Yes. New users receive free credits upon sign-up, which can be used to generate and export
watermark-free images and videos. Additional credits and advanced features can be unlocked by
upgrading to VIP.

### Can I cancel my Remaker AI subscription at any time?

+

Remaker AI uses a one-time credit purchase model with no recurring monthly fees, so there is no
subscription to cancel.

### Can I use Remaker AI on both PC and mobile devices?

+

Yes. Remaker AI works seamlessly on Windows, Mac, iOS, and Android devices. Log in with the same
account and edit or enhance your photos and videos anytime, anywhere.

### Is payment on Remaker AI secure?

+

Yes. All payments are securely processed by Stripe. Remaker AI does not store your card information.
Stripe uses bank-level encryption and security standards to keep your payment information safe.

##### Custom Retail, Industrial, & Consumer Products Packaging Solutions

For over 125 years, we have been an industry-leading designer and producer of customized,
innovative, sustainable, and cost effective packaging products for retailers, industrial and
consumer products manufacturers – from startups to global organizations in just about every
industry. Our packaging protects your products, supports your brand promise, and enhances your brand
value.

Our custom packaging – which includes folding cartons, corrugated boxes, displays, industrial
packaging, gift boxes, e-commerce mailing bags & boxes, and customized packaging & shipping supplies
– is a tangible expression of your company and your brand. Our experience, leadership, and expertise
guarantee great customer service and the best quality products & services.

[Learn More][81]

[Ruskin Group Catalog]

##### In-Stock Packaging and Shipping Products

We stock over 20,000 SKUs of packaging products & shipping supplies in warehouses across the country
to provide the widest range of solutions available for next-day delivery to everyone everywhere.
Stock packaging is ideal for businesses and individuals who need reliable, cost effective products
quickly, whether in one or one hundred locations.

Our industry-leading range of best-in-class products makes us a one-stop-shop for everything you
need to package, store, transport, display, market, and deliver your products. We source these
products from manufacturers around the world to guarantee the best products at the lowest total
costs. If you need to package and/or ship anything, check out [our store][82] today!

#### CONSUMER PRODUCTS PACKAGING SOLUTIONS

newest start-ups. We offer the widest range of products of anyone – from printed folding cartons to
club-store boxes to point-of-purchase displays to corrugated shippers, packers & trays & so much
more. We focus on new products, private label & regional brands, seasonal & promotional packaging at
all stages of your supply chain, with the fastest turnarounds & lowest total costs, from concept to
full-scale production.

[Learn More][84]

[Retail Packaging Products and Services]

#### RETAIL & E-TAIL PACKAGING SOLUTIONS

Our retail packaging is for everyone who sells anything to anyone – from the largest chains to the
latest e-tail & subscription e-commerce businesses. Our products range from the most innovative
in-store gift boxes, shopping bags, displays, & wraps to mailers, envelopes, bags, & everything else
you need to package & ship products directly to consumers – from your warehouse, your store, your
plant, your office, or your home. We help you develop, launch, and scale your company, your brand, &
your products with the widest variety of stock & custom packaging in the industry.

[Learn More][85]

[Packing & Shipping Supplies]

#### PACKAGING & SHIPPING SUPPLIES

We are the only packaging company in the nation to offer custom & stock products in all packaging
categories with over 20,000 SKUs for next-day delivery. Our customers cross every industry –
retailers & e-tailers, industrial & consumer products manufacturers, professional service firms,
hospitality & entertainment businesses, transportation & construction companies, technology & health
care providers, home offices, & individual consumers. We produce, distribute, & source everything
from corrugated boxes, poly bags, & labels to bubble wrap, office, safety & janitorial supplies.

##### Custom Retail, Industrial, & Consumer Products Packaging Solutions

For over 125 years, we have been an industry-leading designer and producer of customized,
innovative, sustainable, and cost effective packaging products for retailers, industrial and
consumer products manufacturers – from startups to global organizations in just about every
industry. Our packaging protects your products, supports your brand promise, and enhances your brand
value.

Our custom packaging – which includes folding cartons, corrugated boxes, displays, industrial
packaging, gift boxes, e-commerce mailing bags & boxes, and customized packaging & shipping supplies
– is a tangible expression of your company and your brand. Our experience, leadership, and expertise
guarantee great customer service and the best quality products & services.

[Learn More][81]

[Ruskin Group Catalog]

##### In-Stock Packaging and Shipping Products

We stock over 20,000 SKUs of packaging products & shipping supplies in warehouses across the country
to provide the widest range of solutions available for next-day delivery to everyone everywhere.
Stock packaging is ideal for businesses and individuals who need reliable, cost effective products
quickly, whether in one or one hundred locations.

Our industry-leading range of best-in-class products makes us a one-stop-shop for everything you
need to package, store, transport, display, market, and deliver your products. We source these
products from manufacturers around the world to guarantee the best products at the lowest total
costs. If you need to package and/or ship anything, check out [our store][82] today!

## The Ruskin Group today is strategically diversified into three primary businesses that work
## together through a common organization.

[Consumer Packaging Solutions]

#### CONSUMER PRODUCTS PACKAGING SOLUTIONS

Our CPG packaging protects, transports, displays, & markets your products to customers in-stores,
on-shelves, & on-line. Our customers range from the most respected & recognized global brands to the
newest start-ups. We offer the widest range of products of anyone – from printed folding cartons to
club-store boxes to point-of-purchase displays to corrugated shippers, packers & trays & so much
more. We focus on new products, private label & regional brands, seasonal & promotional packaging at
all stages of your supply chain, with the fastest turnarounds & lowest total costs, from concept to
full-scale production.

[Learn More][84]

[Retail Packaging Products and Services]

#### RETAIL & E-TAIL PACKAGING SOLUTIONS

Our retail packaging is for everyone who sells anything to anyone – from the largest chains to the
latest e-tail & subscription e-commerce businesses. Our products range from the most innovative
in-store gift boxes, shopping bags, displays, & wraps to mailers, envelopes, bags, & everything else
you need to package & ship products directly to consumers – from your warehouse, your store, your
plant, your office, or your home. We help you develop, launch, and scale your company, your brand, &
your products with the widest variety of stock & custom packaging in the industry.

[Learn More][85]

[Packing & Shipping Supplies]

#### PACKAGING & SHIPPING SUPPLIES

We are the only packaging company in the nation to offer custom & stock products in all packaging
categories with over 20,000 SKUs for next-day delivery. Our customers cross every industry –
retailers & e-tailers, industrial & consumer products manufacturers, professional service firms,
hospitality & entertainment businesses, transportation & construction companies, technology & health
care providers, home offices, & individual consumers. We produce, distribute, & source everything
from corrugated boxes, poly bags, & labels to bubble wrap, office, safety & janitorial supplies.

###### How to work

## — Trasformiamo le tue idee in soluzioni esclusive

### Vent'anni di eccellenza nella comunicazione visiva

Creativa, flessibile, giovane, innovativa, efficiente e motivata… questa è l’essenza di SEVEN Group.
Un’importante realtà aziendale che da oltre vent’anni opera nella comunicazione visiva e nei
molteplici aspetti ad essa collegati.
* CREATIVA con soluzioni sempre innovative
* FLESSIBILE per adattarsi ad ogni esigenza
* GIOVANE come lo spirito ribelle del suo team
* INNOVATIVA e sempre alla ricerca di nuove idee
* EFFICENTE nella pianificazione di ogni attività
* MOTIVATA verso l’eccellenza

### Soddisfare visioni, superare aspettative

Seven Group è un team di esperti che mettono in campo il loro know-how per sviluppare progetti
unici. Con un team di creativi, tecnici, allestitori e montatori siamo in grado di trasformare idee
in soluzioni concrete, mirando sempre a soddisfare la vision del cliente.

La sinergia che li unisce permette di trasformare le idee in soluzioni esclusive e innovative
nell’ambito dell’[allestimento vetrina][22], del [packaging][23], degli [espositori][24] e di tutti
quei prodotti destinati alla promozione del brand e dell’immagine aziendale.

### Una mission ben chiara in testa

I nostri obiettivi principali sono la CUSTOMER SATISFACTION e la CUSTOMER LOYALTY per questo motivo
ogni giorno cerchiamo soluzioni innovative attraverso la ricerca di nuovi materiali, selezionati di
volta in volta in base al tipo di progetto.

La creatività è il nostro asso nella manica, il nostro team di grafici sperimenta e realizza
progetti sempre unici. La fedeltà del cliente è un valore che consideriamo essenziale; la fiducia
che ci accordano e la collaborazione a lungo termine sono indicatori preziosi del nostro impegno
efficace ed efficiente.

## Frequently Asked Questions

[ More FAQs ][40]
What does Shiporo do?

Shiporo is a 3PL logistics company specializing in storage, fulfillment, and pick and pack services.
We handle warehousing and shipping for DTC brands that sell products online, ensuring fast, accurate
order fulfillment from our strategically located warehouses.

What happens when customers place orders on my website?
When a customer places an order on your website, we will be able to see the order and shipping
information on our software.
Does your pricing change during peak season?
Our pricing does not change based on seasonality.
Do items need to be labelled a certain way before shipping to you?
We require that you attach WRO Labels on your master cartons/pallets before shipping to us.

## Frequently Asked Questions

[ More FAQs ][40]
What does Shiporo do?

Shiporo is a 3PL logistics company specializing in storage, fulfillment, and pick and pack services.
We handle warehousing and shipping for DTC brands that sell products online, ensuring fast, accurate
order fulfillment from our strategically located warehouses.

What happens when customers place orders on my website?
When a customer places an order on your website, we will be able to see the order and shipping
information on our software.
Does your pricing change during peak season?
Our pricing does not change based on seasonality.
Do items need to be labelled a certain way before shipping to you?
We require that you attach WRO Labels on your master cartons/pallets before shipping to us.

# O společnosti

**Ve společnosti Stavounie-CZ, s.r.o. ****již více než**** 35 let n****avrhujeme a vyrábíme
spolehlivá, nákladově efektivní a udržitelná obalová řešení pro** **bezpečnou
přepravu**** ****výrobků a produktů** všeho druhu kamkoliv na světě –** po souši, po moři i
letecky.**

**Vyrábíme [exportní obaly][43],** [**zámořské obaly**][44] (s možností balení [**přímo** **u
zákazníka**][45]), **dřevěné [přepravní bedny][46]** **s** [**IPPC/ISPM 15**][47]
**certifikací****,** [**atypické palety**][48] **na míru** **i** **další ochranné a přepravní
obaly** ze dřeva, překližky, OSB a dalších materiálů.

Součástí našeho portfolia jsou také **specializovaná obalová řešení** **pro ochranu** [**citlivých
zařízení a výrobků **][49]**v** **energetice,** **lehkém i těžkém průmyslu,** **letectví** **a
obranném sektoru** (například** ****elektrické rozvaděče,** **turbíny, avionika** **a drony,
proudové** **motory, vojenská** **technika** a další).

**Pro zajištění optimální ochrany** tyto obaly doplňujeme o** speciální výplně na míru, pěnové
vložky a polstrování, i přesné CNC obráběné podpěry a fixační prvky,** které zajišťují **dokonalé
usazení výrobku** a **maximální ochranu** během **manipulace, přepravy a skladování.**

**Díky vlastním výrobním, skladovým a manipulačním prostorům** **o rozloze přes ****45.000 m²,
špičkovému technologickému vybavení** a **komplexní logistické infrastruktuře** (včetně **vlastního
vozového parku,** těžkotonážních VZV a halových jeřábů) realizujeme zakázky všech velikostí.** Od
jednorázových kusových řešení **až po **sériové dodávky s denními návozy.**

**Jsme certifikovaní** dle [**ISO 9001:2015**][50] a [**IPPC/ISPM 15**][51], čímž **garantujeme
bezpečnost a plnou exportní kompatibilitu našich obalů pro celosvětový vývoz.** Současně do obalů
**integrujeme prvky [udržitelnosti][52] a společenské odpovědnosti** ve formě [**PEFC
certifikovaného dřeva**][53] **z udržitelného lesnictví,** používání **recyklovaných** a
**recyklovatelných materiálů,** naplňování **ESG standardů** a kontinuálního **snižování uhlíkové
stopy.**

**Spolehněte se navíce než 35 let zkušeností v oboru výroby ochranných a exportních obalů a
kontaktujte nás nezávazně ještě dnes**. Rádi vyslechneme vaše požadavky a společně najdeme **ideální
obalové řešení pro vaše potřeby – spolehlivé, nákladově efektivní a udržitelné.** [**Nezávazně
poptat!**][54]

 

## **Proč si vybrat Stavounie-CZ pro obalová řešení?**

 **1. ****Spolehlivost a špičková kvalita** – více než 35 let zkušeností v oblasti výroby exportních
a dřevěných obalů.

**2.** **Cenově efektivní řešení **– efektivní výroba díky vlastní infrastruktuře a optimalizovaným
procesům.

**3. ****Individuální obalová řešení** – od jednorázových zakázek po sériovou výrobu, včetně
průmyslového balení přímo u zákazníka.

# O společnosti

**Ve společnosti Stavounie-CZ, s.r.o. ****již více než**** 35 let n****avrhujeme a vyrábíme
spolehlivá, nákladově efektivní a udržitelná obalová řešení pro** **bezpečnou
přepravu**** ****výrobků a produktů** všeho druhu kamkoliv na světě –** po souši, po moři i
letecky.**

**Vyrábíme [exportní obaly][43],** [**zámořské obaly**][44] (s možností balení [**přímo** **u
zákazníka**][45]), **dřevěné [přepravní bedny][46]** **s** [**IPPC/ISPM 15**][47]
**certifikací****,** [**atypické palety**][48] **na míru** **i** **další ochranné a přepravní
obaly** ze dřeva, překližky, OSB a dalších materiálů.

Součástí našeho portfolia jsou také **specializovaná obalová řešení** **pro ochranu** [**citlivých
zařízení a výrobků **][49]**v** **energetice,** **lehkém i těžkém průmyslu,** **letectví** **a
obranném sektoru** (například** ****elektrické rozvaděče,** **turbíny, avionika** **a drony,
proudové** **motory, vojenská** **technika** a další).

**Pro zajištění optimální ochrany** tyto obaly doplňujeme o** speciální výplně na míru, pěnové
vložky a polstrování, i přesné CNC obráběné podpěry a fixační prvky,** které zajišťují **dokonalé
usazení výrobku** a **maximální ochranu** během **manipulace, přepravy a skladování.**

**Díky vlastním výrobním, skladovým a manipulačním prostorům** **o rozloze přes ****45.000 m²,
špičkovému technologickému vybavení** a **komplexní logistické infrastruktuře** (včetně **vlastního
vozového parku,** těžkotonážních VZV a halových jeřábů) realizujeme zakázky všech velikostí.** Od
jednorázových kusových řešení **až po **sériové dodávky s denními návozy.**

**Jsme certifikovaní** dle [**ISO 9001:2015**][50] a [**IPPC/ISPM 15**][51], čímž **garantujeme
bezpečnost a plnou exportní kompatibilitu našich obalů pro celosvětový vývoz.** Současně do obalů
**integrujeme prvky [udržitelnosti][52] a společenské odpovědnosti** ve formě [**PEFC
certifikovaného dřeva**][53] **z udržitelného lesnictví,** používání **recyklovaných** a
**recyklovatelných materiálů,** naplňování **ESG standardů** a kontinuálního **snižování uhlíkové
stopy.**

**Spolehněte se navíce než 35 let zkušeností v oboru výroby ochranných a exportních obalů a
kontaktujte nás nezávazně ještě dnes**. Rádi vyslechneme vaše požadavky a společně najdeme **ideální
obalové řešení pro vaše potřeby – spolehlivé, nákladově efektivní a udržitelné.** [**Nezávazně
poptat!**][54]

 

## **Proč si vybrat Stavounie-CZ pro obalová řešení?**

 **1. ****Spolehlivost a špičková kvalita** – více než 35 let zkušeností v oblasti výroby exportních
a dřevěných obalů.

**2.** **Cenově efektivní řešení **– efektivní výroba díky vlastní infrastruktuře a optimalizovaným
procesům.

**3. ****Individuální obalová řešení** – od jednorázových zakázek po sériovou výrobu, včetně
průmyslového balení přímo u zákazníka.

FAQ

## Custom Packaging Boxes, Common Questions

What is the minimum order quantity for custom packaging boxes? +

Most standard custom box orders start around **50 units**, while specialty structures, regulated
packaging, and certain materials may start at 100+ units. We quote [low-MOQ custom printed
packaging][111], small production runs, and large repeat orders with the same level of detail.

How long does custom packaging production take? +

Turnaround depends on your box structure, finish, material, and quantity, and is locked in once you
approve the digital proof. Standard US shipping is free on every order, and you get delivery
estimates and tracking with your quote.

Do you offer a price match guarantee? +

**Yes.** If you find the same product specification, same material, print method, and quantity, at a
lower price from a competitor, we’ll match it. We’re confident our turnaround time and quality will
still beat the competition.

Do I need a designer to order custom boxes? +

No. Our design team builds your dieline and sets up your artwork for free. Just send us your logo
and brand colors and we handle the rest. We accept AI, PDF, PSD, and PNG files (300 dpi+). Two
rounds of revisions are included at no charge.

Are your packaging materials eco-friendly? +

Yes. **FSC-certified paper options**, soy-based inks, recyclable structures, and biodegradable
material options are available by specification. The right claim depends on your material, coating,
finish, and order requirements. See the [certifications and materials page][112] for claim scope.

Can I order a sample before placing a bulk order? +

Yes. Samples are available before bulk production on most products. [Contact us][113] to request a
sample of your specific box type. We recommend samples for first-time orders with specialty finishes
like foil stamping, soft-touch, or spot UV.

Why Teal Packaging

Teal is built for brands that need small-to-mid custom runs done right in the US. You work with a
free dedicated designer who builds your dieline and sends a digital proof before anything goes to
print, there are no separate plate or setup fees, and the ordering is handled by a US team you can
reach directly. From DTC startups to established retail lines and regulated products, that means
retail-grade full-color printing across mailer boxes, folding cartons, rigid boxes, and bags,
without the high minimums mos

We do more than print your packaging. From our West Chicago fulfillment center we kit, pick and
pack, and ship your custom boxes to individual recipients, so one order can reach hundreds of
addresses.

### [Kitting and Assembly][102]

We assemble your boxes with inserts, tissue, products, and cards, ready to ship as a finished kit.
[Learn more][103].

02

### [Ship to Recipients][104]

Send one order to many people. We label and ship your custom boxes to individual addresses from West
Chicago. [See how][105].

03

### [Storage and 3PL][106]

Warehouse your packaging with us, then we pick, pack, and ship as orders come in, built for small
and growing brands. [Details][107].

[Explore Fulfillment and 3PL →][108]

## Better Quality.

fees.

by specification.

expectations are confirmed during quoting.

We check artwork, materials, and proof approvals before production. If the finished order does not
match the approved proof, we make it right.

06

Most standard custom box orders start around 50 units. Specialty structures and materials may start
at 100+ units, with quantity breaks at 100, 500, and 1,000 units.

FAQ

What is the minimum order quantity for custom packaging boxes? +

Most standard custom box orders start around **50 units**, while specialty structures, regulated
packaging, and certain materials may start at 100+ units. We quote [low-MOQ custom printed
packaging][111], small production runs, and large repeat orders with the same level of detail.

How long does custom packaging production take? +

approve the digital proof. Standard US shipping is free on every order, and you get delivery
estimates and tracking with your quote.

Do you offer a price match guarantee? +

lower price from a competitor, we’ll match it. We’re confident our turnaround time and quality will
still beat the competition.

material options are available by specification. The right claim depends on your material, coating,
finish, and order requirements. See the [certifications and materials page][112] for claim scope.

branded packaging in one cost-effective solution.

Natural brown kraft paper with black logo printing offers budget-friendly custom packaging perfect
for businesses with tight margins. Stylish durability with natural eco-friendly finish communicates
sustainability while providing professional brand presentation.

#### Custom Printed Mailer Boxes:

Full-color printing inside and outside creates premium unboxing experiences customers share on
social media. The ultimate branded packaging solution that customers might keep rather than discard.

#### Perfect for:
* E-commerce stores (Shopify, WooCommerce)
* Amazon FBA sellers
* Dropshipping businesses
* Subscription box services
* Direct-to-consumer brands

Custom rigid boxes and product boxes create premium positioning for higher-value products requiring
retail-quality presentation.

* Premium materials and specialty papers
* Foil stamping, embossing, spot UV options
* Inside color printing for luxury unboxing
* Custom inserts for product protection

* Beauty and cosmetics brands
* Jewelry and watches
* Electronics and tech accessories
* Premium consumer goods
* Corporate gifts and promotions
* Subscription boxes (luxury tier)

The most discreet way to ship goods with added wow factor. Kraft paper with inside color print
creates sophisticated brand moments.

Custom product boxes work exceptionally well for products sold both online and in retail stores –
one packaging solution for multiple channels.

[ Explore Custom Product Boxes ][32]
[shredded paper]

### Custom Packaging Inserts

Packaging inserts are the highest-ROI custom packaging investment – small additions creating massive
business impact.

#### Insert Cards:

Request reviews, offer discount codes, share brand stories, or provide care instructions. Custom
insert cards cost just $0.10-0.20 but increase review rates 2-3x and drive 30-40% repeat purchase
rates.

#### Thank You Cards:

Personal touches that build emotional connections with customers, turning transactions into
relationships.

#### Additional Insert Options:
* Custom stickers (brand building and customer engagement)
* Branded tissue paper (premium presentation)
* Shredded paper filler (product protection with branding)
* Product information inserts (reduce returns and support tickets)

 

An add-on that increases customer retention and brand awareness at minimal cost. Smart e-commerce
businesses view packaging inserts as essential marketing infrastructure, not optional extras.

Starting from 500 cards | Multiple sizes available | Full customization

[ Explore Packaging Inserts ][33]

### Custom Shipping Bags & Mailers

Custom poly mailers and shipping bags provide lightweight, cost-effective branded packaging for soft
goods and non-fragile products.

#### Custom Poly Mailers:

Waterproof, tear-resistant custom mailer bags with full-color logo printing. Perfect for apparel,
accessories, textiles, and lightweight products where rigid boxes aren’t necessary.

## Benefits:
* Dramatically reduce shipping costs (80-90% lighter than boxes)
* Waterproof protection (products arrive dry)
* Space-efficient storage (ships and stores flat)
* Fast fulfillment (peel, insert, seal)
* Eco-friendly options available (compostable materials)

## Perfect for:
* Fashion brands
* Apparel dropshippers
* Businesses shipping soft goods

Ideal for fashion brands, apparel dropshippers, and any business shipping soft goods. Custom mailer
bags provide professional branding at lowest possible packaging cost and weight.

Starting from 500 bags | Multiple sizes | Eco options

##### Delivery Options:
* Direct to China Suppliers: Free delivery anywhere in China to your product suppliers, fulfillment
  centers, or shipping agents
* International Shipping: Available to locations worldwide (costs vary by destination and volume)
* Amazon FBA Centers: Direct delivery to Amazon fulfillment centers (US, Europe, Japan, etc.)
* Warehouse/3PL: Ship to your third-party logistics providers

**Why China Delivery Matters:** Most e-commerce products manufacture in China. By delivering custom
packaging to your Chinese suppliers, you eliminate expensive international freight for empty boxes –
products and packaging ship together to customers, dramatically reducing total logistics costs.

This strategic approach is especially valuable for dropshipping businesses, Amazon FBA sellers, and
e-commerce brands sourcing products from China.

**No endless back-and-forth. No middlemen markup. Just simple, seamless custom packaging service.**

## Complete Custom Packaging Solutions - Print It Your Way

Every business needs different custom packaging based on products, brand positioning, target
customers, and business model. We offer complete custom packaging solutions designed for modern
e-commerce:

rigid boxes][29] for luxury brand positioning, to strategic [packaging inserts][30] that drive
reviews and repeat purchases – we provide custom packaging options matching your specific needs. All
custom packaging includes free design support, quality manufacturing, and transparent pricing.

tailored to your unique requirements:

### Custom Mailer Boxes

Custom mailer boxes are the backbone of e-commerce packaging – combining shipping container and
branded packaging in one cost-effective solution.

#### Kraft Mailer Boxes (Eco Option):

Natural brown kraft paper with black logo printing offers budget-friendly custom packaging perfect
for businesses with tight margins. Stylish durability with natural eco-friendly finish communicates
sustainability while providing professional brand presentation.

#### Custom Printed Mailer Boxes:

Full-color printing inside and outside creates premium unboxing experiences customers share on
social media. The ultimate branded packaging solution that customers might keep rather than discard.

#### Perfect for:
* E-commerce stores (Shopify, WooCommerce)
* Amazon FBA sellers
* Dropshipping businesses
* Subscription box services
* Direct-to-consumer brands

Starting from 1,000 units | Self-locking design | Ships flat

[gift box]

### Custom Product Boxes

Custom rigid boxes and product boxes create premium positioning for higher-value products requiring
retail-quality presentation.

## Features:
* Two-piece lid/tray construction or magnetic closure
* Premium materials and specialty papers
* Foil stamping, embossing, spot UV options
* Inside color printing for luxury unboxing
* Custom inserts for product protection

## Perfect for:
* Beauty and cosmetics brands
* Jewelry and watches
* Electronics and tech accessories
* Premium consumer goods
* Corporate gifts and promotions
* Subscription boxes (luxury tier)

The most discreet way to ship goods with added wow factor. Kraft paper with inside color print
creates sophisticated brand moments.

Custom product boxes work exceptionally well for products sold both online and in retail stores –
one packaging solution for multiple channels.

[shredded paper]

Packaging inserts are the highest-ROI custom packaging investment – small additions creating massive
business impact.

#### Insert Cards:

Request reviews, offer discount codes, share brand stories, or provide care instructions. Custom
insert cards cost just $0.10-0.20 but increase review rates 2-3x and drive 30-40% repeat purchase
rates.

#### Thank You Cards:

Personal touches that build emotional connections with customers, turning transactions into
relationships.

#### Additional Insert Options:
* Custom stickers (brand building and customer engagement)
* Branded tissue paper (premium presentation)
* Shredded paper filler (product protection with branding)
* Product information inserts (reduce returns and support tickets)

 

An add-on that increases customer retention and brand awareness at minimal cost. Smart e-commerce
businesses view packaging inserts as essential marketing infrastructure, not optional extras.

Starting from 500 cards | Multiple sizes available | Full customization

[ Explore Packaging Inserts ][33]

Custom poly mailers and shipping bags provide lightweight, cost-effective branded packaging for soft
goods and non-fragile products.

#### Custom Poly Mailers:

Waterproof, tear-resistant custom mailer bags with full-color logo printing. Perfect for apparel,
accessories, textiles, and lightweight products where rigid boxes aren’t necessary.

## Benefits:
* Dramatically reduce shipping costs (80-90% lighter than boxes)
* Waterproof protection (products arrive dry)
* Space-efficient storage (ships and stores flat)
* Fast fulfillment (peel, insert, seal)
* Eco-friendly options available (compostable materials)

## Perfect for:
* Fashion brands
* Apparel dropshippers
* Businesses shipping soft goods

Ideal for fashion brands, apparel dropshippers, and any business shipping soft goods. Custom mailer
bags provide professional branding at lowest possible packaging cost and weight.

Starting from 500 bags | Multiple sizes | Eco options

For brands ready to invest in packaging as marketing, fully custom projects deliver:

Private-label and custom watch manufacturing for brands worldwide. Selected low-MOQ programmes start from just 25 watches.
Design · Development · Manufacturing · Quality Control · Packaging · Global Delivery
Choose from selected watch designs and customize your logo on the dial, caseback and packaging.
Applies to selected existing designs and branding configurations. Fully custom OEM development follows a project-specific MOQ.
From precise quartz essentials to automatic and bespoke programmes, each collection begins with the customer, positioning and commercial brief.
We do not simply manufacture watches. We help brands turn a product idea into a coherent, market-ready collection.
Understand the brand, customer, market, positioning and target price.
Develop the case, dial, hands, movement, strap, bracelet, colours, finishes and packaging.
Create samples for design, engineering and commercial validation.
Select the production ecosystem that fits the specification, volume, quality and target cost.
Build inspection and testing into development, approval and production.
Prepare retail-ready watches and packaging for delivery to the customer's market.
Every watch programme has different requirements for design, materials, quantity, cost and lead time. We coordinate the production route around the approved specification rather than forcing every project into the same factory.
Representative assembly imagery. Facilities, processes and testing scope are confirmed for each approved production route.
For brands, retailers, e-commerce teams, corporations and international buyers who need more than a catalogue product.
Extend your brand into a commercially relevant watch collection.
Develop distinctive collections backed by experienced watch-industry specialists.
Build exclusive private-label watch programmes for your customers and channels.
Create bespoke watches for gifting, recognition, events and special programmes.
House of Brands is led by Rajan Mehta, a Mechanical Engineer from REC Kurukshetra and MBA from IIM Calcutta, with more than 25 years of experience across product development, OEM, licensing, retail and e-commerce in the watch industry. His international experience includes five years based in the Netherlands with responsibility across Asia and the Middle East.

Yes. Private-label, white-label and OEM routes can apply your approved identity to the dial, caseback, packaging and collateral, subject to the chosen specification.

They can be customized to different degrees. Feasibility, commercial terms and development work depend on the chosen construction, materials, quantity and supplier minimums.
Send us a sketch, reference image, existing watch or simply an idea. Our team will help determine the right development and manufacturing route for your project.

## An End-to-end Creative Packaging Solution

Packaging is part of the product. It’s the first tangible brand connection. Our experience-driven
design narrates your product, revealing layers of meaning in your brand story. Through award-winning
design, state-of-the-art manufacturing, and intelligent logistics, we create and produce the most
innovative [custom packaging solutions][50].

### [ Strategy][51]

[][52]

We offer design strategy insights across fields such as custom packaging design, sustainability,
brand-system packaging, PR packaging and swag curation, packaging engineering, and emerging
materials.

### [ Design][53]

[][54]

Our branding, graphic, and structural design experts build custom packaging from the ground
up—balancing premium aesthetics, sustainable material selection, and structural engineering.

### [ Manufacturing][55]

[[Workers operating large blue printing machinery for package manufacturing in an industrial
facility.][Workers operating large blue printing machinery for package manufacturing in an
industrial facility.]][56]

We transform complex designs into precise, production-ready manufacturing blueprints. From sourcing
to rapid lab prototyping, we validate every structure down to the Golden Sample, ensuring flawless
execution during high-volume mass production.

### [ Logistics][57]

[[Conveyor system moving boxes within a packaging logistics warehouse with storage racks in the
background.][Conveyor system moving boxes within a packaging logistics warehouse with storage racks
in the background.]][58]

We simplify complex global supply chains by anchoring your logistics under one roof. Zenpack’s
network spans critical trade routes across North America, Southeast Asia, and Central America. We
handle everything from state-of-the-art container optimization and package kitting to strict retail
channel compliance.
